title: Rust & Leverage
subtitle: Dockmaster Renn has a dead drifter's manual, a Syndicate tariff problem, and a fresh Kestrel beacon.

start.title: Iron Dust & Gantry Sparks
paragraphs: Red iron dust needles the creases of your vac-collar before your boots even clear {{ship}}'s boarding ladder. Across the cracked ferro-concrete pad, Siltport's moisture vaporators wheeze like tired bellows, and a hand-painted windsock snaps furiously above a rusted crane.

Dockmaster Renn drops his arc-torch, pushes his soot-smudged visor up onto his forehead, and tosses a scorched field manual onto your cargo crate. Its leatherette cover is blistered black along the spine.

"Good timing, {{firstName}}," Renn rasps, tapping a cracked telemetry slate with one grease-darkened knuckle. "Picked up a weak distress pulse an hour ago. Courier brig Kestrel, sheared clean in the Inner Drift. Crew might still be breathing in the aft ward-bubble—or maybe the Ledger Syndicate already has cutters burning toward her."

choices.label: "Before I undock—what's actually going on in this port? The cranes are half-dead."
choices.hint: Ask Renn about Siltport's history and why the outpost is hurting

onSuccess.resultText: Renn looks past the perimeter fence toward the dry dust-flats, his jaw tightening.

choices.label: "What's the Ledger Syndicate want with a broken courier brig?"
choices.hint: Press Renn on the Syndicate's interest in the Kestrel

onSuccess.resultText: Renn glances toward the customs tower and lowers his voice beneath the wind.

choices.label: "The Kestrel wasn't hauling ore. I know Syndicate cipher-manifests."
choices.hint: Syndicate Defector insight — claim a fuel advance and uncover the tithe ledger

onSuccess.resultText: Renn whistles low through his teeth. "Then you already know why Collector Vane-Kael is sweating bullets. Take the dead pilot's manual and thirty credits for fuel."

choices.label: "Siltport's own don't leave crews in the dark, Renn. Give me the vector."
choices.hint: Driftborn Human solidarity (+1 Warden, +1 Renn Trust)

onSuccess.resultText: Renn claps a heavy, grease-stained hand on your shoulder. "That's the Siltport spine talking. Take the manual and a spare salvage crate."

choices.label: "Sounds like you need leverage on Vane-Kael, not just a tug. Let's talk terms."
choices.hint: Freebooter Envoy insight — negotiate an upfront retainer

onSuccess.resultText: Renn cracks a dry half-smile. "Sharp ears, envoy. Twenty credits out of the gantry petty-box just for listening—now hear me out."

renn_siltport_history.title: Built on Rust & Promises
paragraphs: "Three wreck-diving families welded this pad together out of freighter ribs sixty years back," Renn says quietly. "Under the Rim Accord, Siltport was supposed to be a free anchorage. No Core tax, no customs liens—just honest salvage."

"Then seven years ago, our main vaporators choked during a six-month dust siege. People were rationing condensation off the hull-plates. So I signed an emergency water-bailout rider with the Ledger Syndicate. Thought we'd pay it off in two seasons. Instead, Collector Vane-Kael buried us in penalty clauses."

choices.label: "And the Kestrel is your chance to break his grip."

onSuccess.resultText: Renn nods once, his eyes hard behind the dust-streaked glass of his visor.

renn_context.title: Behind the Tariff
paragraphs: "Three days ago, Vane-Kael doubled our docking tithe without warning," Renn mutters. "Claims Siltport owes forty days' back-interest on beacon maintenance—and if we don't clear it, he'll impound the gantry cranes."

"Funny thing is, the Kestrel was flying Syndicate clearance, carrying their own blackbox telemetry. Whatever sheared her spine out in the Inner Drift wasn't pirate plasma. If you pull survivors or her blackbox out of that gravel eddy, we finally have leverage. Or if you strip her bare, at least Siltport eats."

choices.label: "I hear you. What are my terms for taking the vector?"

onSuccess.resultText: Renn slides the scorched manual across the crate. "Name your creed before you undock, cap."

creed_choice.title: Terms of Undocking
paragraphs: "Everyone on the rim makes a choice sooner or later," Renn says, resting both palms on the crate. "The Drift doesn't reward half-measures. Are you going out there for the people trapped in that ward-bubble, or for the salvage bounty?"

choices.label: "Survivors first, scrap second. You have my word, Renn."
choices.hint: Marks your creed (+1 Oathkeeper, +1 Renn Trust) and grants the Drifter's Manual

onSuccess.resultText: Renn's weathered jaw loosens a fraction. "Good. Not many left on the rim who still mean that. Flip through the dead pilot's notes before you jump."

choices.label: "I'm no charity tug. Give me exclusive salvage rights and fuel money."
choices.hint: Marks your creed (+1 Cutthroat, -1 Renn Trust) and squeezes extra credits

onSuccess.resultText: Renn spits into the red dust and stamps your clearance chit. "Cold as vacuum. Fine—strip her to the ribs if you beat the Syndicate there."

choices.label: "I'll pull whoever's breathing if I can, and bill the port a fair hazard fee."
choices.hint: Balanced contract terms (+10 Credits, keeps things strictly professional)

onSuccess.resultText: Renn grunts and signs the berth voucher. "Fair enough. No heroics promised, no lies told."

manual_pick.title: Marik Vance's Margin Notes
paragraphs: Back at the boarding ramp, SABLE-7 projects an amber scan over the scorched manual. On the inside cover, someone has written a name in faded grease-pencil: *Marik Vance — Tug 4*.

"Renn didn't mention who owned this," SABLE-7 murmurs, her hologram tilting slightly. "Two chapters remain legible, {{firstName}}: coil-tuning tables for frontier plasma rifles, and emergency bypass diagrams for blown rune-relays. Which discipline shall I archive to your tactical HUD before we explore Siltport or undock?"

choices.label: "Archive the Plasma Marksmanship coil tables."
choices.hint: Learn Plasma Marksmanship

onSuccess.resultText: You memorize the recoil-compensation cadence and vent-valve timing. Your grip on the carbine feels steadier already.

choices.label: "Archive the Scrap Jury-Rigging bypass diagrams."
choices.hint: Learn Scrap Jury-Rigging

onSuccess.resultText: You commit the copper-shunt schematics to memory—ready to coax dead bulkheads back to life.

parting_beat.title: Before the Jump
paragraphs: "Vector locked," SABLE-7 confirms. "The Kestrel's beacon isn't going anywhere in the next hour, and Cantina Row is right across the berm if you want to check the rumor brokers or catch up on ship diagnostics first. Whenever you're ready, we burn for the Inner Drift."

choices.label: "Copy that, SABLE. Let's see who's still awake in Siltport."

onSuccess.resultText: You tuck the scorched manual into your coat and step back onto Siltport's dust-swept apron.

title: Smoke & Tin Shutters
subtitle: A hooded aether-broker hawks forbidden weaves beside Old Iron Bramwell in Cantina Row.

start.title: Behind the Tin Shutters
paragraphs: Under a sputtering neon sigil that buzzes like a trapped wasp, Rust & Cantina Row smells of scorched copper, cheap rust-gin, and wet iron dust. The Copper Kettle's tin shutters rattle on rusted hinges, half-boarded against the wind.

At the edge of an oil-drum brazier, a hunched woman in a ash-gray cowl spreads two silver-etched data wafers across a crate. One hums with delicate phase-shift geometry; the other is stamped with dense Syndicate cipher-keys.

"Fresh off a dead relay, {{race}}," Sister Mirek whispers, her pale, faintly scarred eyes tracking your hands rather than your face. "One bends plasma around ward-shields. The other cracks Syndicate locks. Two stools over, a broad-shouldered salvager in a brass-riveted lung-filter watches silently."

choices.label: "Where did a cantina broker get Syndicate cipher-keys—and why are you hiding your eyes?"
choices.hint: Probe Mirek's motives and earn her respect

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek's thin lips curl beneath the edge of her hood.

choices.label: "That phase-wafer is Pre-Collapse weave. Don't insult me with street prices."
choices.hint: Aether-Elf resonance — claim a discount and lore (+1 Mirek Trust)

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek hisses softly, pulling her hood lower. "Sharp ears, starfarer. Fine—I won't pad the margin on someone who can hear the lattice."

choices.label: "Skip the mystery. What's the price on the wafers?"

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek taps a fingernail against the silver etching, brisk and businesslike.

mirek_probe.title: Ash-Glass Eyes
paragraphs: "In Siltport, everything washes ashore eventually," Mirek murmurs. "Dead couriers, discarded transponders, captains who thought they could outrun a Syndicate cutter. As for my eyes—let's just say I stared into a singing relay too long when I was young, and paid the tuition."
She tilts her head toward the man by the brazier. "And Old Iron there? He keeps the alley quiet so my customers don't get spaced before they pay. Pick your edge, {{firstName}}."

choices.label: "Alright. Show me what the wafers can do."

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek slides both silver wafers forward into the amber brazier light.

wafer_deal.title: Silver & Ciphers
paragraphs: "Thirty credits and a shard for the phase-weave, twenty for the Syndicate cipher," Mirek says. "Or if you've got the nerve, see if you can read the phase-geometry before I snatch it back. Just know that if it bites you, you owe me a favor."

choices.label: Read the Phase-Weaving wafer by resonance alone
choices.hint: Resonance check (DC 6) — learn Phase-Weaving free, or take Void-Touched scar & owe Mirek a favor

onSuccess.resultText: The wafer's silver filaments flare cyan against your fingertips. You drink in the Phase-Weaving geometry before Mirek can even blink—she laughs softly and snaps her sleeve back.

onFailure.resultText: The wafer bites back with a cold static lash, numbing your wrist and etching frost-blue lines beneath your skin—yet the pattern burns into your sight. Mirek scratches a chalk tally beside her shutter: "You owe me one, {{firstName}}."

choices.label: Pay 30 Credits & 1 Aether Shard for the Phase-Weaving wafer

onSuccess.resultText: You slide the coin and shard across the drum. Mirek's gaunt fingers vanish them, leaving you the complete Phase-Weaving schematics.

choices.label: "No haunted tricks—give me the Void Cryptography cipher-wafer."
choices.hint: Cold-iron pragmatism (+1 Purist), costs 20 Credits

onSuccess.resultText: "Clean math," you mutter, pocketing the Syndicate cipher-keys while Mirek counts your credits.

choices.label: "Not buying today, Sister. Just looking around the row."

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek shrugs and folds her wafers into silk. "Suit yourself. Doors stay open."

bramwell_intro.title: The Brass Lung-Filter
paragraphs: As Mirek melts back into the alley mist, the broad-shouldered salvager taps the brass cylinder strapped to his chest. Every breath he draws clicks softly through a copper valve.

"You've got the look of someone heading past the inner buoys, {{firstName}}," Bramwell rumbles, gesturing to the overturned crate beside his brazier. "Name's Bramwell. Folks call me Old Iron because my lungs gave out before my spine did. Pull up a seat a minute."

choices.label: "You've been diving the Drift a long time. What happened out there?"
choices.hint: Ask about Bramwell's past and the Inner Drift wrecks

onSuccess.resultText: Bramwell stares into the coals of the brazier for a long beat before speaking.

choices.label: "Renn's got me pointed at the Kestrel. What do you know?"

onSuccess.resultText: Bramwell nods slowly, tapping ash from his pipe.

bramwell_beat.title: Old Iron's Offer
paragraphs: "Back in the Tariff Wars, half these hulks were escort cutters," Bramwell says. "Now the Syndicate owns the buoys and charges us rent on our own air. Siltport needs steady hands on the ground—or a captain who pays fair for good wreck intel."

choices.label: "The Copper Kettle's open again, Bramwell. Take a berth as quartermaster."

onSuccess.resultText: Bramwell grins behind his respirator. "A warm hearth and real gin? You've got yourself an Outpost Quartermaster, cap. My salvage leads—and my Exchange buyers—are yours."

choices.label: "Tell me what you know about Syndicate patrols around the Kestrel."
choices.hint: Presence check (DC 6) — earn Bramwell's recruitment & salvage, or owe him a tab

onSuccess.resultText: You match Bramwell's dry humor drink for drink. Satisfied, he marks two unpicked hull-lockers and a Syndicate blind-spot on your slate, and agrees to watch Siltport's Exchange for you.

onFailure.resultText: Bramwell grunts. "Talk is cheap in the Drift, and I don't work for free. Take one salvage tip on a tab—we'll settle up later."

choices.label: "I fly solo, old-timer. Keep your war stories."
choices.hint: Marks your horizon (+1 Lone Drifter, -1 Bramwell Trust)

onSuccess.resultText: Bramwell raises his tin mug in mock salute. "Watch your six out past the buoys, lone wolf."

title: Breach at the Kestrel
subtitle: The courier brig hangs vitrified in a gravel eddy—and a Syndicate cutter is burning hard toward you.

start.title: Vitrified in Vacuum
paragraphs: Floodlights from {{ship}} sweep across the gravel eddy, catching shards of spinning frost and shattered copper. At the center hangs the courier brig *Kestrel*—or what's left of her.

She hasn't been torn apart by plasma fire. The entire ship is sheared cleanly across the mid-deck, her steel bulkheads melted into translucent blue-black glass. Worse, her entire forward bridge and prow are simply gone.

"Aft ward-bubble is still holding pressure, {{firstName}}," SABLE-7 reports, zooming the canopy feed. Inside a fractured viewport, a woman in a scorched artificer coat waves a sparking copper gauntlet. "Warning: Ledger Syndicate patrol cutter *Bailiff's Debt* just cleared Buoy 7. ETA: three minutes."

choices.label: "Sweep the eddy first—where's the rest of the ship?"

onSuccess.resultText: SABLE-7 pings the surrounding rock. No forward hull within fifty kilometers—just a fading harmonic wake drifting toward the Mid-Drift.

choices.label: "No time to gawk. Bring us in on the aft airlock."

onSuccess.resultText: Thrusters hiss as you nose {{ship}} into the slow-tumbling debris ring.

breach_approach.title: The Aft Ward-Bubble
paragraphs: Torn copper rune-cables whip lazily around the *Kestrel*'s aft docking collar. The airlock iris is dead, its relay box fused by whatever vitrified the ship's spine. Through the viewport, the artificer's breath fogs thick against the glass.

choices.label: Shunt the blown airlock relay with Scrap Jury-Rigging
choices.hint: Tech check (DC 6) with +3 Scrap Jury-Rigging bonus

onSuccess.resultText: You bridge the dead relay with braided copper. The airlock iris groans open cleanly without spilling a drop of cabin pressure.

onFailure.resultText: A shorted capacitor arcs across your visor, scorching {{ship}}'s docking collar and tripping the wreck's emergency transponder—but the lock cycles open.

choices.label: Let Aether-Spectrum Sensors guide a zero-impact tether dock
choices.hint: Guile check (DC 6) with +3 Sensors Lv.2 bonus

onSuccess.resultText: Your upgraded sensors thread the needle between whipping rune-cables, kissing the Kestrel's hull without a single spark.

onFailure.resultText: A stray gravel eddy slams {{ship}}'s flank during docking, denting plating and jarring the transponder awake before the mag-clamps lock.

choices.label: Cut straight through the dead collar bolts using salvage-torch instincts
choices.hint: Wreck-Salvager / Ironkin insight — clean mechanical entry

onSuccess.resultText: You spot the manual pressure-dog beneath the vitrified rim in three seconds and pop the hatch clean.

choices.label: Ram the jammed hatch open with raw hull mass
choices.hint: Grit check (DC 7) — fast, loud, and leaves a mark

onSuccess.resultText: You gun the attitude thrusters and shear the jammed bolts clean off. Brutal, loud, and effective.

onFailure.resultText: The impact buckles a forward rib and trips the wreck's distress siren—yet the hatch tears free.

vexra_meeting.title: Sparks in the Smoke
paragraphs: Inside the flickering ward-bubble, the air tastes like burnt silver and cold sweat. Vexra Korr clutches a soot-blackened crystalline cylinder—the *Kestrel*'s sigil-drive blackbox—against her chest with one trembling arm.
"Thank the stars," she gasps, staggering toward your airlock. "Wait—scan the eddy! My brother Taren was on the forward bridge when the lattice snapped. Is the fore-hull out there?"

choices.label: "The fore-hull's gone deeper into the Drift, Vexra. Grab the blackbox—we'll track it down."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra's throat works silently for a second, then she nods hard and straps the blackbox to her hip. "Then we don't let the Syndicate bury it."

choices.label: "No sign of the bow. Never mind that—what's inside that cylinder?"

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra flinches at the bluntness, clutching the cylinder tighter. "Nothing good. Get us clear of the eddy first."

halden_standoff.title: The Bailiff's Debt
paragraphs: Before you can unclamp, your comms crackle with an imperial chime. The *Bailiff's Debt* sweeps out of the rust-haze, twin forward plasma lances glowing dull crimson.

"Unregistered vessel, power down your thrusters," Captain Halden barks across the open band. "That sigil-drive blackbox and the artificer are Ledger Syndicate property under Rim Charter 14. Comply, or we log your hull as hostile."

choices.label: Fire a warning burst with your Phase-Vanishing Carbine across Halden's bow
choices.hint: Magi-Tech Synergy — phases straight through Syndicate deflector screens!

onSuccess.resultText: Your plasma bolt blinks through Halden's forward ward-screen and scorches his sensor mast. "Crazy rim-rats!" Halden barks, breaking off pursuit.

choices.label: "Stand down, Halden. I know Ledger-Cutter clearance codes—you're out of jurisdiction."
choices.hint: Syndicate Defector bluff — Guile check (DC 6)

onSuccess.resultText: Halden hesitates at your crisp Sector-Four protocol phrasing. By the time he verifies the code, you and Vexra are already burning out of the eddy.

onFailure.resultText: Halden doesn't buy the bluff. He rakes your stern with warning fire and tags your transponder before you yank Vexra clear.

choices.label: Run a hard burn through the gravel eddy to shake the Syndicate cutter
choices.hint: Guile check (DC 7) — slip the cutter clean, or eat fire and get transponder-tagged

onSuccess.resultText: You kill your running lights and coast behind a tumbling slag-chunk while Halden's cutter overshoots into the dust.

onFailure.resultText: Halden clips your port stabilizer and locks a tracking tag onto your hull as you break clear—rattling the bulkheads, though Vexra and the blackbox are aboard.

choices.label: "Wait, Halden. Let me keep the hull scrap, and I'll hand over the blackbox copy."
choices.hint: Cutthroat deal (+1 Cutthroat) — avoid combat, pocket Syndicate hush-credits, and make Vexra a rival

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra stares at you in disbelief as you transmit a telemetry dump to the Bailiff's Debt. Halden wires fifty credits and waves you clear.

aftermath_hero.title: Aboard The Cinder Lark
paragraphs: Once clear of the gravel eddy, Vexra exhales hard and sets the humming blackbox on your console. Her hands are still shaking from adrenaline and cold.

"You didn't have to risk your hull for me, {{firstName}}," she says softly. "If you'll have me at Siltport, I'll cut your shipwright costs and help crack what's inside this cylinder—and maybe we'll find out where the Kestrel's bow went."

choices.label: "Welcome to Siltport, Vexra. Let's see what the Syndicate was hiding."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra clasps your forearm—her copper gauntlet still warm. "Meet me at the Landing Pad when you're ready to decode this."

aftermath_deal.title: Cold Vacuum, Full Hold
paragraphs: Vexra pulls her collar tight as you drop her at the nearest airlock buoy, clutching the original blackbox shard she hid in her boot.
"You're sharp, I'll give you that," she says, her voice flat as sheet iron. "Keep the scrap—just don't expect me to forget you sold out the Kestrel."

choices.label: "Business is business, artificer."

onSuccess.resultText: You still recovered the physical blackbox core from the wreckage—enough for SABLE-7 to analyze back at Siltport.

title: Echoes in the Kestrel's Ribs
subtitle: Rival scavenger Rook is cutting into the Kestrel's lower reactor deck.

start.title: Torch-Light in the Wreck
paragraphs: Blue cutting-sparks flicker inside the Kestrel's cargo spine. A wiry diver in a patched vac-suit—Rook—waves a plasma cutter toward your helmet lamp. "Easy there, {{firstName}}! Plenty of copper left on this carcass if we don't trip the forward capacitor."

choices.label: "Split the deck: you ground the relays, I'll pull the heavy plates."
choices.hint: Presence check (DC 6) — cooperative haul with Rook

onSuccess.resultText: Rook nods behind his visor. "Deal. Watch the third rib—it's still hot." Together you haul two clean pallets and split the yard-bounty.

onFailure.resultText: Rook takes the easier conduit bundle and leaves you wrestling a seized bulkhead bolt, though you still sell off a decent copper coil.

choices.label: "This wreck's under my salvage lien, Rook. Back off the deck."
choices.hint: Grit check (DC 7) — claim the whole sector, or trigger a scuffle

onSuccess.resultText: Rook backs toward his skiff with both hands raised. "All yours, boss." You claim the prime coils.

onFailure.resultText: Rook kicks a loose strut into your hull as he jets clear, denting plating before you can lock on—though you still grab a handful of relay chits.

capacitor_beat.title: The Hum Beneath
paragraphs: "Residual aether charge detected in the port manifold, {{firstName}}," SABLE-7 warns. "We can bleed it into an Aether Shard, or leave it dark."

choices.label: Siphon the residual charge with a tech probe
choices.hint: Tech check (DC 6) — extract +1 Aether Shard, or risk feedback

onSuccess.resultText: The crystal locks cleanly into your collector, glowing pale cyan.

onFailure.resultText: The capacitor pops in a shower of ozone, scorching your gloves—though a jagged shard still tumbles into your net.

choices.label: Leave the hot manifold alone and return to {{ship}}

onSuccess.resultText: You seal your cargo net and jet back to the airlock intact.

title: Inside the Kestrel Blackbox
subtitle: Act I Climax — Decode the crystalline cylinder with Vexra to uncover what the Syndicate was hiding.

start.title: A Shattered Frequency
paragraphs: On Siltport's landing pad, the *Kestrel* blackbox sits clamped in Vexra's copper cradle, pulsing in slow cyan triplets. Around you, gantry cranes groan in the evening wind while Dockmaster Renn's arc-lamps cast long shadows across the ferro-concrete.

Vexra adjusts her magnifying goggles and taps the casing with a brass caliper. "Look at the harmonic signature, {{firstName}}. The Syndicate told everyone the Kestrel was hauling copper. She wasn't. She was mapping Pre-Collapse Monolith relays out past the outer reef—and carrying something else inside her cipher shell."

choices.label: Strip the Syndicate encryption with Void Cryptography
choices.hint: Guaranteed clean decode + unlocks Pre-Collapse Lattice & Fore-Hull lore

onSuccess.resultText: Your cipher-keys peel the Syndicate shell back in seconds, spilling crisp telemetry across Vexra's slate.

choices.label: Read the Pre-Collapse lattice glyphs directly
choices.hint: Ley-Archive Scholar insight — Lore check (DC 5)

onSuccess.resultText: You recognize the harmonic notation immediately—unlocking the outer shell cleanly as the lattice clicks into place.

onFailure.resultText: The cipher fights back, leaving your temples throbbing, yet the core coordinates spill across the slate.

choices.label: Coax the telemetry core open with careful Lore & Tech
choices.hint: Lore check (DC 6)

onSuccess.resultText: The crystal hums and projects its sealed partition cleanly onto Vexra's bench.

onFailure.resultText: A static pop cracks the outer casing, scorching your wrist—yet the core data survives intact.

blackbox_revelation.title: Three Truths in the Static
paragraphs: Vexra freezes as three files unfold in midair. First: accounting headers proving Collector Vane-Kael **forged Siltport's penalty interest** to justify impounding the port.
Second: a Deep Frontier star-chart triangulating an ancient basalt obelisk—**The Singing Monolith**—alongside Choir of Ash relay frequencies.

Third—Vexra's breath catches—a single, faint distress ping from the **missing *Kestrel* fore-hull**, drifting somewhere in the Mid-Drift. "Taren's beacon," she whispers. "It pulsed once after the shear. Before we go chasing the deep reef or facing Vane-Kael, take a breath and tell me how we're preparing."

choices.label: "First, take stock. Everything we just survived changed how I fly."

onSuccess.resultText: You lean back against the fuel drum, letting the dust settle as the implications sink in.

act1_reflection.title: Act I Milestone · Hard-Won Edge
paragraphs: "Act I telemetry archived," SABLE-7 notes quietly. "Between Siltport's docks and the *Kestrel* breach, you've sharpened your instincts under real pressure. Which discipline carried you through—and will define how you handle Vane-Kael?"

choices.label: Grit — enduring vacuum shocks and holding the line (+1 Grit)

onSuccess.resultText: Your shoulders settle—harder to rattle, harder to break.

choices.label: Guile — slipping patrols and reading Syndicate bluffs (+1 Guile)

onSuccess.resultText: You've learned to move before anyone thinks to look.

choices.label: Tech — coaxing dead copper and jury-rigged locks (+1 Tech)

onSuccess.resultText: Your hands know every relay and weld-seam by touch.

choices.label: Presence — rallying dockhands and staring down captains (+1 Presence)

onSuccess.resultText: When you speak on the gantry, people listen.

choices.label: Lore — piecing together Pre-Collapse charts and ciphers (+1 Lore)

onSuccess.resultText: Dead languages and old manifests are starting to connect.

choices.label: Resonance — hearing the Lattice hum beneath the metal (+1 Resonance)

onSuccess.resultText: The three-note pulse feels less like noise and more like a compass.

training_offer.title: Preparation for the Reef
paragraphs: "Now you know why Vane-Kael wants Siltport squeezed dry and the Deep Frontier sealed," Vexra says, wiping soot from her brow. "If you're going to face the Collector or whatever's singing out past the buoys, take one of these techniques before you go."

choices.label: Practice Aether Warding grounding sigils
choices.hint: Learn Aether Warding

onSuccess.resultText: You etch your first clean grounding sigil into a scrap plate, watching harmonic static bleed harmlessly into the deck.

choices.label: Study Void Cryptography from the decoded Syndicate headers
choices.hint: Learn Void Cryptography

onSuccess.resultText: You copy the Syndicate cipher-keys into your wrist-slate—ready for locked vaults and customs relays.

choices.label: "I already know those. Just pack me a couple Aether Shards."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra tosses two clean shards into your pouch. "Fair enough, {{firstName}}. Fly sharp."

title: Blackbox on the Ramp
subtitle: Act I Climax — Without Vexra, SABLE-7 projects a diagnostic cradle to crack the Kestrel's cylinder.

start.title: Cold Telemetry
paragraphs: No artificer waits at the Siltport pad—only the wind and the hum of your own boarding ramp. SABLE-7 projects a pale cyan diagnostic cradle over the *Kestrel*'s crystalline blackbox.

"Without Korr's tuning fork, we'll have to brute-force the outer seal ourselves, {{firstName}}," SABLE-7 notes. "The Syndicate logged this vessel as an ore courier, yet its carrier frequency matches Pre-Collapse Monolith relays."

choices.label: Strip the Syndicate encryption with Void Cryptography
choices.hint: Guaranteed clean decode + unlocks Pre-Collapse Lattice & Fore-Hull lore

onSuccess.resultText: Your cipher-keys peel the Syndicate shell back in seconds.

choices.label: Read the Pre-Collapse lattice glyphs directly
choices.hint: Ley-Archive Scholar insight — Lore check (DC 5)

onSuccess.resultText: You recognize the harmonic notation immediately—mapping the relay and exposing the forged tariff ledger.

onFailure.resultText: The cipher fights back, leaving your temples throbbing, yet the core coordinates spill across the slate.

choices.label: Coax the telemetry core open with SABLE-7's array
choices.hint: Lore check (DC 6)

onSuccess.resultText: The crystal hums and projects its sealed partition cleanly onto the ramp.

onFailure.resultText: A static pop cracks the outer casing, scorching your wrist—yet the core telemetry survives intact.

sable_revelation.title: Three Truths in the Static
paragraphs: "Three encrypted partitions recovered," SABLE-7 announces. "First: Collector Vane-Kael falsified Siltport's penalty interest. Second: the *Kestrel* was triangulating an ancient basalt obelisk—The Singing Monolith—in the Deep Frontier."
"Third: the *Kestrel*'s missing fore-hull emitted one weak beacon from the Mid-Drift after the shear. Whatever happened out there, it isn't finished."

choices.label: "Archive it all. I need a second to take stock of what we just walked into."

onSuccess.resultText: You sit on the boarding ramp, watching red dust drift across the lit pad.

act1_reflection.title: Act I Milestone · Hard-Won Edge
paragraphs: "Act I telemetry archived," SABLE-7 notes quietly. "Which discipline carried you through—and will define how you handle Vane-Kael?"

choices.label: Grit — enduring vacuum shocks and holding the line (+1 Grit)

onSuccess.resultText: Your shoulders settle—harder to rattle, harder to break.

choices.label: Guile — slipping patrols and cutting cold deals (+1 Guile)

onSuccess.resultText: You've learned to move before anyone thinks to look.

choices.label: Tech — coaxing dead copper and jury-rigged locks (+1 Tech)

onSuccess.resultText: Your hands know every relay and weld-seam by touch.

choices.label: Presence — staring down captains and commanding rooms (+1 Presence)

onSuccess.resultText: When you speak on the gantry, people listen.

choices.label: Lore — piecing together Pre-Collapse charts and ciphers (+1 Lore)

onSuccess.resultText: Dead languages and old manifests are starting to connect.

choices.label: Resonance — hearing the Lattice hum beneath the metal (+1 Resonance)

onSuccess.resultText: The three-note pulse feels less like noise and more like a compass.

sable_archive_pick.title: Salvaged Schematics
paragraphs: "Two intact training packets survived inside the Kestrel's engineering partition. Which should I compile for you before we face Vane-Kael or the outer reef?"

choices.label: Compile Aether Warding grounding sigils
choices.hint: Learn Aether Warding

onSuccess.resultText: You etch your first clean grounding sigil into a spare deck plate, watching harmonic static bleed harmlessly away.

choices.label: Compile Void Cryptography from the Syndicate headers
choices.hint: Learn Void Cryptography

onSuccess.resultText: You copy the Syndicate cipher-keys into your wrist-slate—ready for locked vaults and customs relays.

choices.label: "Archive the data and bleed the blackbox capacitor for Aether Shards."

onSuccess.resultText: SABLE-7 vents the spent cylinder cleanly, leaving two usable Aether Shards in your tray.

title: Ghosts in the Nav-Core
subtitle: SABLE-7 reports a rhythmic harmonic pulse—and memories that aren't in her manifest.

start.title: Three-Note Static
paragraphs: With the cockpit shutters dimmed against Siltport's floodlights, {{ship}} feels smaller—just warm copper conduits ticking as they cool, and the faint smell of ozone.
Without a hand on the stick, the nav-slate flickers cyan. Three low, resonant notes pulse through the bulkhead behind your seat, vibrating right up the base of your skull.

"{{firstName}}," SABLE-7 says, her synthesized voice unusually quiet. "This isn't a sensor glitch. Something beyond the outer Syndicate buoys is pinging our nav-core directly—and it's using an old call-sign from before you bought this hull."

choices.label: "Old call-sign? Tell me about the captains who flew The Cinder Lark before me."
choices.hint: Get to know SABLE-7's history (+1 SABLE-7 Trust)

onSuccess.resultText: SABLE-7's holographic projector dims a fraction, as if pulling a curtain across the canopy.

choices.label: "Isolate the carrier wave first, SABLE. Where is it coming from?"

onSuccess.resultText: SABLE-7 projects a wireframe of the Deep Frontier—highlighting an uncharted basalt obelisk: The Singing Monolith.

sable_history.title: Stitched Telemetry
paragraphs: "I wasn't built as one mind," SABLE-7 admits softly. "When {{ship}} was decommissioned, a dockyard tech patched my nav-matrix from three previous flight recorders. Orlov, who braided these copper conduits. A courier who never spoke on open band. And Captain Tessa."

"Tessa heard that three-note pulse out past the Glass Shoals and jumped alone. I still have her last aborted vector locked in my partition. Sometimes I can't tell if I'm running diagnostics... or remembering her."

choices.label: "You're not just their echoes, SABLE. You're my copilot now."

onSuccess.resultText: The amber status ring around SABLE-7's projector steadies into a warm, even glow. "Thank you, {{firstName}}. Isolating the carrier wave now."

choices.label: "Keep that partition quarantined. Show me the signal source."

onSuccess.resultText: "Quarantine confirmed," SABLE-7 replies, brisk again. "Projecting the Deep Frontier carrier vector."

harmonic_choice.title: Resonance or Cold Iron
paragraphs: "Our current Drive and Sensors can't survive the outer-reef turbulence yet," SABLE-7 notes, pointing to a towering basalt obelisk on the wireframe. "We'll need Drive Lv. 2 or Sensors Lv. 2 to reach that obelisk. Meanwhile, the signal is still live in our conduits. How do you want to handle it?"

choices.label: Lay your palm on the warm ley-conduit and listen
choices.hint: Resonance check (DC 6) — attune to the signal and draw a clean shard

onSuccess.resultText: For three heartbeats, you hear an ancient star-chorus—vast, patient, and waiting. A raw shard condenses in the collector.

onFailure.resultText: White-hot static snaps up your forearm, etching frost-blue capillaries beneath your skin before SABLE-7 dumps the buffer.

choices.label: Clamp a cold-iron grounding busbar across the console
choices.hint: Tech check (DC 6) — purge the ghost cleanly (+1 Purist)

onSuccess.resultText: You lock the coordinates first, then ground the bleed into clean copper. No whispers in your cockpit.

onFailure.resultText: The busbar arcs and blows two fuses, though SABLE-7 still locks the Monolith's sector vector before the screen clears.

sable_mentorship.title: Copilot's Archive
paragraphs: The cockpit settles back into quiet hums. "While the nav-core cools, I can run a late-night drill on the canopy slate," SABLE-7 offers. "Would you rather drill Pre-Collapse chart notation, or practice reading harmonic drift by ear?"

choices.label: "Pull up the Pre-Collapse star-charts. Let's study the dead lanes." (+1 Lore)

onSuccess.resultText: You spend an hour tracing ancient relay vectors with SABLE-7 until the glyph-notation clicks.

choices.label: "Loop the three-note harmonic. Teach me to hear the drift." (+1 Resonance)

onSuccess.resultText: SABLE-7 hums the carrier wave softly through the cockpit speakers until your spine answers in kind.

title: The Unmarked Urn
subtitle: A panicked courier in Cantina Row needs a lead-wrapped Choir relic moved past Syndicate scanners.

start.title: Whisper at the Brazier
paragraphs: A dust-cloaked runner slides onto the bench beside you, breathing hard beneath a scarred breather-scarf. Cradled in her arms is a heavy cylinder wrapped in crinkled lead foil. Even muffled, it hums against your ribs like a distant cello.

"You're {{name}}, captain of {{ship}}," Lyra whispers, her eyes darting toward the alley entrance where customs floodlights sweep the tin awnings. "Syndicate locked down the main pad. Get this urn into your hold until my buyer clears port—fifty credits, no questions asked."

choices.label: "No blind cargo on my ship. Peel back the foil and show me what's singing."
choices.hint: Lore check (DC 6) — uncover Choir lore before deciding

onSuccess.resultText: You peel a corner of foil back. Beneath lies Pre-Collapse quartz etched with Void Choir notation—a resonant memory-urn.

onFailure.resultText: The hum spikes as you touch the foil, numbing your fingertips, yet you recognize the Pre-Collapse Choir seal stamped on the lid.

choices.label: "Fifty credits is fifty credits. Stash it in my pack and stay out of sight."

onSuccess.resultText: Lyra exhales in relief and slips the heavy urn into your pack before vanishing behind a stack of rust-gin barrels.

urn_truth.title: Song in the Lead
paragraphs: "Alright, you caught me," Lyra admits softly, pulling her scarf down. "It's a Choir relay-urn from the outer reef. My buyer isn't Syndicate—they're Choir remnants trying to keep their dead's voices out of a corporate vault. Help me keep it off their ledger."

choices.label: "I'll stow it aboard {{ship}}. Keep your head down."

onSuccess.resultText: You tuck the Choir urn under your coat just as booted footsteps crunch down the alley.

choices.label: "Pre-Collapse Choir tech? The price just doubled to eighty credits."

onSuccess.resultText: Lyra's jaw tightens, but with Syndicate flashlights sweeping the lane, she has no choice. She slaps extra chits into your palm.

syndicate_sweep.title: Customs Sweep
paragraphs: Two Syndicate inspectors in slate-gray coats block the alley mouth, sweeping handheld aether-sniffers across crates. "Hold it, {{race}}," the lead inspector barks, his sniffer whining faintly toward your coat. "Routine contraband sweep. Open your pack."

choices.label: Talk your way past the sweep
choices.hint: Guile check (DC 6) — keep the urn clean, or trigger a rooftop bolt & transponder tag

onSuccess.resultText: You flash an old dock-manifest and steer their sniffer toward a crate of sour rust-gin. The inspectors wave you on with a grunt.

onFailure.resultText: The sniffer chirps sharp and loud. You kick an oil drum into the inspector's shins and bolt through a side-awning as their scanner pings your wrist-transponder.

choices.label: "I found this abandoned by the brazier—looks like Choir contraband."
choices.hint: Hand the urn to the Syndicate for a finder's bounty (+1 Cutthroat, makes Lyra a rival)

onSuccess.resultText: The inspector's eyes widen as he scans the urn. He tosses you a hefty Syndicate bounty chit—though from the shadows above the awning, Lyra watches you with cold, unforgiving eyes.

lyra_aftermath_ally.title: Clean Hand-Off
paragraphs: Later that night, Lyra drops down from the Copper Kettle's awning and presses a pouch of credits and a pale shard into your palm. "Clean work, {{firstName}}. Most captains fold the second an inspector blinks. If you ever want a drink on the roof, look for my lantern."

choices.label: "See you on the roofline, Lyra."

onSuccess.resultText: Lyra taps two fingers to her temple and vanishes back into the alley mist.

lyra_aftermath_chase.title: Rooftop Exit
paragraphs: A hand yanks you through a corrugated vent hatch just as stun-bolts hiss past your shoulder. Lyra drags you across two tin roofs before you both catch your breath.
"They tagged your transponder," she winces, pressing thirty-five credits into your hand. "Sorry it got messy, {{firstName}}—but you saved the urn. I won't forget that."

choices.label: "Just make sure your buyer pays double next time."

onSuccess.resultText: You slip back down to the pad, keeping clear of the main floodlights.

title: Ledger of Dust
subtitle: Catch Dockmaster Renn alone under the gantry overhang during a red-dust squall.

start.title: Under the Overhang
paragraphs: A red-dust squall rolls across the flats, drumming against Siltport's corrugated gantry shelters like gravel. The pad is empty save for Dockmaster Renn, sitting on an overturned cable spool with an unlit stub of synth-leaf between his fingers.

He looks older without the arc-torch glare—shoulders slumped beneath his oilskin coat, a folded yellow paper charter resting on his knee. "Storm'll pass in twenty minutes, {{firstName}}. Pull up a crate if you're not in a rush."

choices.label: "Is that the Rim Accord paper you mentioned?"

onSuccess.resultText: Renn turns the brittle paper over in his calloused hands.

choices.label: "Marik Vance—the name in the manual. Who was he to you?"

onSuccess.resultText: Renn's fingers go still on the synth-leaf.

renn_marik.title: Tug Four
paragraphs: "Kid who flew supply runs out of the Inner Drift," Renn says quietly. "Twenty-two years old. Thought if he hauled enough copper, he'd buy Siltport out from under Vane-Kael's penalty rider. His drive coil blew three kilometers short of the pad."
"I keep his manual on the crate so I don't forget what it costs when I send a pilot out into the dust."

choices.label: "You carry the whole port on your back, Renn. What's in that charter?"

onSuccess.resultText: Renn exhales a long breath and unfolds the yellow sheet.

renn_confession.title: The Bailout Rider
paragraphs: "Seven years ago, when the vaporators died, my granddaughter was six months old," Renn says, not looking up. "Vane-Kael brought water tanks in a Syndicate cutter and laid this rider across my desk. Said it was a temporary loan."
"Every port hand thinks the Syndicate squeezed us out of nowhere. They don't know I signed the collar onto Siltport's neck myself."

choices.label: "You kept the port alive, Renn. Nobody blames a man for buying water."

onSuccess.resultText: Something tight in Renn's shoulders finally gives way. "Wish I could believe that as easily as you say it, cap."

choices.label: "Guilt won't unhook those cranes. We use whatever leverage we find."

onSuccess.resultText: Renn nods slowly, folding the charter back into his coat. "You're right. Sentiment's heavy."

renn_mentorship.title: Gantry Lessons
paragraphs: The squall begins to thin, revealing amber floodlights along the perimeter fence. Renn stands and picks up a heavy iron spanner. "Still got fifteen minutes before the cranes spin back up. Want me to show you how to hold a dock crowd, or how to brace for a heavy haul?"

choices.label: "Teach me how you keep this crew together when Vane-Kael's men show up." (+1 Presence)

onSuccess.resultText: Renn walks you through sixty years of dockyard politics—who owes whom, and how to make a crowd listen without shouting.

choices.label: "Show me the manual gantry-winch drills—hard iron and steady hands." (+1 Grit)

onSuccess.resultText: You haul rusted chain-blocks beside Renn until your forearms burn and your breathing steadies.

title: Brazier & Rust-Gin
subtitle: Share a late-shift mug with Old Iron Bramwell and hear why he never left Siltport.

start.title: Late Shift in the Alley
paragraphs: Cantina Row is quiet after the last cargo shift. Bramwell sits beside a low-burning coke brazier with a rag, a tin of valve oil, and his brass lung-filter laid open in pieces across a clean cloth.

Without the respirator, his breathing sounds like dry leaves scraping across steel. He spots your boots in the doorway and jerks his chin toward a spare tin mug. "Still upright, {{firstName}}? Pour yourself a finger of gin. Don't mind the rattle."

choices.label: "How long have you been running on brass lungs, Bramwell?"

onSuccess.resultText: Bramwell screws a copper gasket back into place with practiced, scarred thumbs.

choices.label: "Heard I owe you for that salvage tip earlier. Let's square up."

onSuccess.resultText: Bramwell waves a hand. "Keep your coin—sitting down for a drink squares it plenty."

bramwell_story.title: The Aether-Pocket
paragraphs: "Nineteen years," Bramwell says, fitting the respirator back over his chest until the valve clicks into rhythm. "End of the Tariff Wars. My crew—four of us—dove an old Syndicate escort hulk before the capacitor bled down."

"Hull cracked into an aether-pocket. Blew my visor clean off. I dragged two of 'em back to the skiff breathing raw shard-dust the whole way. Been anchored to this brass tin ever since—and watching rookies like you so nobody else makes the same dumb bet."

choices.label: Raise your tin mug: "To the ones who made it back, and the ones who didn't."

onSuccess.resultText: Bramwell clinks his mug against yours with a dull metallic ring. "Aye. Now you understand why I stay in this dust-hole."

bramwell_mentorship.title: Old Iron's Craft
paragraphs: "Before you head back out to the wrecks," Bramwell says, tapping his kit bag, "let me pass on something useful. Want to drill zero-g endurance and shock recovery, or how to read a dead ship's weld-seams?"

choices.label: "Show me how to take a hull-shock without blacking out." (+1 Grit)

onSuccess.resultText: Bramwell drills you on breathing cadences, mag-boot bracing, and riding out decompression jolts.

choices.label: "Teach me how to read a dead ship's weld-seams and capacitor load." (+1 Tech)

onSuccess.resultText: By the brazier's light, Bramwell sketches hull-stress diagrams in the ash until you can spot a hot manifold at a glance.

title: Copper & Ghosts
subtitle: Late at night in the Magi-Tech Bay, Vexra works on a broken compass and opens up about the Kestrel.

start.title: Under the Brass Lamp
paragraphs: The swinging brass lamp above {{ship}}'s workbench casts warm pools of amber across scattered solder-wire and quartz filings. Vexra is hunched over the slate, her copper gauntlet unbuckled beside her, trying to coax a cracked brass ley-compass back into alignment with a tiny silver needle.

She doesn't hear you step through the hatch until the bulkhead clicks. "Oh—hey, {{firstName}}," she says, quickly wiping soot from her cheek with the back of her wrist. "Couldn't sleep. Too quiet on the pad."

choices.label: "Whose compass is that?"

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra sets the silver needle down carefully, staring at the cracked dial.

choices.label: Pour two mugs of hot hull-kettle tea and lean against the bench.

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra wraps both hands around the warm tin mug, letting out a breath she seems to have been holding since the Kestrel.

vexra_taren.title: Taren's Compass
paragraphs: "My brother Taren's," Vexra says quietly. "I built the relay-key the *Kestrel* was carrying—thought it was just a Syndicate survey contract. Taren only signed on as navigator because I told him the pay was safe."

"When whatever hit us sheared the ship in half, the ward-bubble sealed behind me. I watched the fore-deck drift into the dark with him still on the bridge. If that blackbox ping was real... he might still be breathing out there."

choices.label: "We'll find the fore-hull, Vexra. You have my word."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra looks up, her bright eyes steady in the lamplight. "Careful making promises like that to an artificer, {{firstName}}. I hold people to their specs."

choices.label: "I won't lie about the odds—but we will follow that ping and find out."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra nods once. "Honest. I can work with honest."

vexra_moment.title: Close Quarters
paragraphs: She reaches across the bench to adjust the lamp, her fingers brushing yours over the cool slate. For a heartbeat, neither of you pulls away—the reactor bulkhead humming softly between you.

choices.label: Let your hand linger a second: "Stay as long as you need, Vexra."
choices.hint: Optional slow-burn spark with Vexra

onSuccess.resultText: A faint flush rises on Vexra's cheekbones, and she smiles—small, unguarded, and genuine.

choices.label: Give her shoulder a steady squeeze: "Get some rest after this, sparks."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra laughs softly, the tension breaking cleanly. "Alright, cap. Deal."

vexra_mentorship.title: Benchwork
paragraphs: "Before you turn in," Vexra says, picking up her etching needle, "my hands need something to focus on. Want to work on precision sigil-soldering, or tuning raw aether resonance?"

choices.label: "Show me precision sigil-soldering and relay-work." (+1 Tech)

onSuccess.resultText: You spend an hour beside Vexra splicing micro-busbars until your welds are clean as factory work.

choices.label: "Teach me how to feel harmonic balance in raw quartz." (+1 Resonance)

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra guides your palm over a singing shard until you can feel the exact frequency where copper meets aether.

title: The Quiet Behind the Glass
subtitle: After hours behind Cantina Row's tin shutters, Sister Mirek reveals why she burned out her sight.

start.title: Tea & Ash-Glass
paragraphs: The neon sigil above Sister Mirek's stall is switched off, leaving only a single blue alcohol-lamp burning behind the corrugated shutter. She sits cross-legged on a crate, grinding dried desert-sage in a mortar.
"You walk louder than you think, {{firstName}}," she says without turning around. "Come in out of the wind. No wafers for sale tonight."

choices.label: "About that chalk tally on your shutter—let's talk about what I owe you."

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek smiles thinly and wets her thumb to wipe the chalk mark clean. "Consider it paid in curiosity—if you actually listen."

choices.label: "Why 'Sister'? You don't carry yourself like a street fence."

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek pours pale sage tea into two clay cups and pushes one toward you.

mirek_confession.title: Former Choir
paragraphs: "Because I took vows once," Mirek says, lifting her hood back for the first time. Faint silver-white scars trace the corners of her pale eyes like frost on glass. "With the Void Choir remnants out beyond the Glass Shoals."

"We were taught to listen to the broken Lattice—to carry its memories in our heads. After ten years, I couldn't tell my own thoughts from dead navigators. So I pressed a hot copper wire to my own optic nerves, severed my resonance, and ran."

choices.label: "That took terrible nerve, Mirek. No wonder you hate the Choir's ghosts."

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek's pale eyes soften a fraction. "Careful, {{firstName}}. Understanding people in this alley is a dangerous habit."

choices.label: "And now you sell their scraps to keep tabs on them."

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek inclines her head. "Better to hold the leash than wear it."

mirek_moment.title: Blue Lamplight
paragraphs: She leans closer across the crate, close enough that you catch the sharp scent of sage and cold ozone. "You're not like the usual rim-rats, {{firstName}}. You actually look at what's behind the curtain."

choices.label: "Only when the company's worth the risk, Mirek."
choices.hint: Optional slow-burn spark with Mirek

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek's lips curve into a rare, unguarded smile. "We'll see how sharp you stay when the deep reef wakes."

choices.label: "Information keeps us both breathing. Keep me in mind."

onSuccess.resultText: "Always," Mirek replies smoothly, folding her hands.

mirek_mentorship.title: Broker's Trade
paragraphs: "Before you go," Mirek says, tapping her slate, "take something worth more than a wafer. Want to learn how to slip a Syndicate tail, or how to read Choir cipher-notation?"

choices.label: "Teach me how to read a street tail and vanish cleanly." (+1 Guile)

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek walks you through alley blind-spots, decoy manifests, and how to read an inspector's eye-line.

choices.label: "Show me the Choir's old harmonic notation." (+1 Lore)

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek sketches three-part Choir glyphs in the dust, explaining the dead syntax behind every singing relic.

title: Roofline & Signal Fires
subtitle: Meet Courier Lyra above Cantina Row to watch the customs beacons and learn why she runs Choir relics.

start.title: Above the Tin Awnings
paragraphs: A warm yellow lantern hangs from the corner of the Copper Kettle's corrugated roof. When you climb the maintenance ladder, you find Lyra sitting with her boots dangling over the alley, tossing salted rust-nuts into the dark.

"Didn't think you'd actually climb up, {{firstName}}," she grins, tossing you half a ration bar. "Best view in Siltport—you can watch every Syndicate patrol shuttle from up here without paying a docking fee."

choices.label: "Why risk Syndicate stun-batons hauling Choir urns?"

onSuccess.resultText: Lyra's grin fades into something quieter as she looks out toward the black horizon.

lyra_story.title: Listening-Post Nine
paragraphs: "My mother worked relay maintenance on Listening-Post Nine," Lyra says, rolling a brass nut between her knuckles. "Six years ago, a Syndicate bailiff declared the post 'harmonically contaminated,' sealed the airlocks, and towed it into the dark."
"Those Choir urns? Half of them carry voice-imprints from old relay crews. When I smuggle one out of Syndicate hands, I'm making sure nobody else gets erased into a ledger."

choices.label: "You've got a good heart under all that grease, Lyra."

onSuccess.resultText: Lyra laughs softly, bumping her shoulder against yours. "Don't spread that around—it'll ruin my smuggler rates."

lyra_moment.title: Between Patrols
paragraphs: A distant Syndicate cutter's beacon sweeps the outer flats, painting the tin roof amber for two seconds before fading back to starlight. Lyra turns to face you, knees pulled up.

choices.label: "Next time you need a fast ship—or company on the roof—call me first."
choices.hint: Optional slow-burn spark with Lyra

onSuccess.resultText: Lyra catches your sleeve and grins—brighter than the lantern beside her. "Careful, cap. I might take you up on both."

choices.label: "Anytime you need a clean hold, {{ship}}'s ramp is open."

onSuccess.resultText: "Best offer I've had all year," Lyra says warmly.

lyra_mentorship.title: Runner's Tricks
paragraphs: "Here—before the next patrol sweeps over," Lyra says, hopping to her feet. "Want me to show you how to duck a port sniffer, or how to bluff a customs chief?"

choices.label: "Show me how to spoof a customs sniffer." (+1 Guile)

onSuccess.resultText: Lyra teaches you how to mask thermal signatures and pack lead-foil decoys.

choices.label: "Teach me how to read a dock inspector and talk them down." (+1 Presence)

onSuccess.resultText: You trade mock interrogations with Lyra until your delivery is calm, effortless, and convincing.

title: Silt-Line Courier Run
subtitle: Move local port manifests, spare parts, or untaxed parcels across Siltport for reliable Credits.

start.title: Alley Dispatch
paragraphs: Fresh chalk postings crowd the notice slate outside the Copper Kettle: vaporator seals needed on the east berm, an untaxed spare coil for a grounded skiff, and a quiet customs-lane errand paying hard Credits.

choices.label: Bribe a corrupt customs clerk to scrub your Syndicate transponder tag (-20 Cr)
choices.hint: Removes your Syndicate transponder tag cleanly

onSuccess.resultText: Twenty credits changes hands behind a fuel drum. Two minutes later, the blinking amber warning LED on your cockpit cowling goes dark.

choices.label: Run an untaxed parcel past the gantry checkpoints
choices.hint: Guile check (DC 5) — 38 Cr on success, 22 Cr on detour

onSuccess.resultText: You slip past the customs floodlights without breaking stride and collect the full runner's fee.

onFailure.resultText: A patrol whistle forces you through the drainage culvert, costing you time and a bruised knee—yet the buyer still pays.

choices.label: Haul heavy vaporator valves across the pad with steady Presence & Grit
choices.hint: Presence check (DC 5) — 35 Cr + Salvage bonus on clean haul

onSuccess.resultText: You coordinate two dockhands cleanly, delivering the valves ahead of schedule for a crisp payout.

onFailure.resultText: A seized crane slows the job, trimming your bonus—though the yard boss still pays your base wage.

courier_bonus.title: Shift Complete
paragraphs: "Credits logged to shipboard ledger," SABLE-7 reports. "Need anything else before we hit the pad?"

choices.label: Pocket the chits and wrap up the shift

onSuccess.resultText: Clean work, steady coin—another day survived on the Silt-Line.

title: The Singing Prow
subtitle: Board the vitrified forward half of the Kestrel to confront the shear—and decide Taren Korr's fate.

start.title: Half a Ship in Glass
paragraphs: The *Kestrel*'s severed forward prow hangs canted inside a halo of blue-black glass splinters, turning lazily in the Mid-Drift current. Where the mid-deck should be, vitrified bulkheads catch your floodlights like dark stained glass.

"One faint thermal signature behind the forward bridge bulkhead," SABLE-7 reports. "And an unstable Choir relay-key pulsing at 4.2 kilohertz. If that key spikes again, the entire ward-bubble will implode."

choices.label: "Stay on my six, Vexra. We're cutting straight to the bridge."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra's copper gauntlet sparks as she mag-locks her boots to the airlock rim.

choices.label: Hail the rusted salvage skiff already clamped to the *Kestrel*'s prow

onSuccess.resultText: Your comms crackle—Vexra Korr is already inside the airlock, cutting her own way toward the bridge.

vexra_forehull_entry.title: Through the Vitrified Deck
paragraphs: Inside the shattered corridor, frost hangs in still clouds around glowing copper conduits. Through a buckled viewport, a young navigator in a torn *Kestrel* flight jacket—Taren Korr—slams a wrench against the jammed blast-door.

"Taren!" Vexra shouts over the suit-comms, dropping to her knees beside the fused relay-key housing. "The harmonic coil is locked in feedback! If I pull the key blind, the ward-bubble drops and vents him—help me crack this cleanly!"

choices.label: "Hold steady. Tell me where the harmonic shunt is."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra points a trembling finger at the singing quartz core.

vexra_rival_entry.title: Unfinished Business
paragraphs: You step through the frost-rimmed corridor to find Vexra bracing a plasma cutter against the jammed bridge door. Behind the viewport, Taren Korr presses one pale hand to the glass.
Vexra doesn't lower her cutter as your boots ring on the deck. "Stay out of my way, {{firstName}}. You left me at a buoy once—I'm pulling my brother out with or without you."

choices.label: "Put the torch down before you blow the ward-seal. I'm helping you pull him out."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra hesitates a fraction of a second, then nods tightly and steps back to the relay housing.

choices.label: "Step aside, artificer. The relay-key core is mine."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra snarls behind her visor, backing against the bulkhead as you step up to the pulsing console.

taren_rescue.title: The Choir Relay-Key
paragraphs: The relay-key whines higher, vibrating through your boots. Three options—and less than forty seconds before the ward-bubble collapses.

choices.label: Ground the singing relay-key with Aether Warding or Phase-Weaving
choices.hint: Resonance check (DC 7, +3 with Aether Warding or Phase-Weaving)

onSuccess.resultText: You bleed the harmonic surge cleanly into your gauntlet. The blast-door hydraulics hiss, and Taren stumbles into the corridor coughing frost.

onFailure.resultText: The relay-key shrieks and fractures, slamming harmonic static across your suit—the blast-door jams halfway!

choices.label: Bypass the fused blast-door hydraulics with Scrap Jury-Rigging
choices.hint: Tech check (DC 7, +3 with Scrap Jury-Rigging)

onSuccess.resultText: You bridge the dead actuator with spare copper braid. The door grinds open wide enough to drag Taren clear.

onFailure.resultText: The copper shunt melts in a shower of sparks, welding the actuator halfway!

choices.label: Wedge a crowbar into the buckled frame and force the door by main strength
choices.hint: Grit check (DC 8) — brute force against vacuum pressure

onSuccess.resultText: With a groan of tearing alloy, you wrench the door clear and haul Taren out by his collar.

onFailure.resultText: The crowbar bends and slips, bruising your ribs as the warning klaxon hits redline!

choices.label: Rip the unstable relay-key core out now and leave the bridge to vent
choices.hint: Cutthroat extraction (+3 Aether Shards, +70 Cr, +1 Cutthroat — Taren dies & Vexra becomes a bitter rival)

onSuccess.resultText: You yank the singing quartz core straight out of its cradle. Behind the glass, the ward-bubble snaps dark in a silent flash of frost.

taren_desperate_choice.title: Ten Seconds to Implosion
paragraphs: "The bubble's tearing!" Vexra screams, bracing her copper gauntlet against the cracking viewport. "Ram {{ship}}'s collar into the frame to hold pressure, or we have to jump back now!"

choices.label: Slam {{ship}}'s docking collar into the breach to hold pressure and pull Taren out (-22 Hull)
choices.hint: Brutal hull toll, but saves Taren Korr (+Unbroken)

onSuccess.resultText: Steel shrieks as {{ship}}'s collar takes the full implosion shock—cracking ribs aft, yet holding long enough for Taren to tumble through.

choices.label: Cut losses and sprint back to the airlock before the prow vents

onSuccess.resultText: You drag Vexra backward through the hatch just as the forward ward-bubble shatters into silent vacuum.

taren_saved_aftermath.title: Breathing Air
paragraphs: On {{ship}}'s deck, Taren Korr pulls off his cracked visor and gulps recycled air while Vexra wraps an emergency thermal blanket around his shoulders. He reaches into his flight pocket and presses a battered brass ley-compass into your palm.
"Take it," Taren rasps. "That compass pointed straight at the Monolith before the key sheared us. And if you need a witness against Vane-Kael's 'ore courier' lie—I'm alive to give it."

choices.label: "Rest up, Taren. We're taking this straight back to Siltport."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra meets your eyes across the deck—quiet, fierce gratitude replacing every ounce of doubt.

taren_lost_aftermath.title: Silent Glass
paragraphs: The *Kestrel*'s prow drifts quiet behind you, its bridge lights extinguished forever. Among the loose debris drifting past your airlock scoop, SABLE-7 recovers a battered brass ley-compass that somehow survived the shear.

choices.label: "Log the fore-hull as lost and set course."

onSuccess.resultText: You stow the silent brass compass on the console and burn clear of the vitrified shards.

title: Ironkin & Ash
subtitle: Visit Forgemaster Durn's smelter-barge to rally Ironkin weld-crews for Siltport—and settle old debts.

start.title: The Twin Barges
paragraphs: Heat radiates even through {{ship}}'s canopy as you dock at The Slag Foundry. Two colossal ore-barges, welded snout-to-snout, pulse with open-vacuum induction arcs. Ironkin engineers in soot-blackened pressure rigs swing heavy Tariff War hull plates from magnetic cranes.
Forgemaster Durn—broad as an airlock frame, beard braided with copper wire—waits by the gantry collar with a heavy spanner across his shoulder. "State your tonnage and your business, {{race}}."

choices.label: Watch the upper catwalk—shadowy figures are dropping onto your docking collar!

onSuccess.resultText: Courier Lyra steps out from behind a slag hopper, flanked by two hired rim-runners with plasma pistols drawn.

choices.label: "I'm flying out of Siltport. Came to talk honest iron and Syndicate tariffs."

onSuccess.resultText: Durn's dark eyes narrow beneath heavy soot-stained brows, weighing your words.

lyra_ambush.title: Price of a Betrayal
paragraphs: "Thought you could hide out in the Mid-Drift, {{firstName}}?" Lyra calls down from the catwalk, her voice tight with anger. "You handed my Choir urn to Syndicate inspectors like a common snitch. Pay the courier guild back—or we take it out of your hull."

choices.label: Draw steel and drive Lyra's runners off the catwalk
choices.hint: Grit check (DC 7, +3 with Plasma Marksmanship or Phase Carbine)

onSuccess.resultText: Two crisp plasma bolts shatter the catwalk floodlights. Lyra and her runners scatter into the foundry ducts.

onFailure.resultText: A grazing shot scorches your shoulder and dents {{ship}}'s collar before Durn's Ironkin guards break up the brawl.

choices.label: Toss a thirty-five credit chit onto the deck: "Take your cut and walk."

onSuccess.resultText: Lyra snatches the chit, spits into the slag pit, and melts back into the shadows. "We're even—until we aren't."

durn_parley.title: Weight & Torque
paragraphs: Durn leads you to the warm foundry rail overlooking a crucible of molten hull-alloy. "We heard Collector Vane-Kael is tightening the screws on Siltport. Good port—Renn never shorted us on scrap weight. Still, backing a dust-town against Syndicate cutters costs iron. Why should my weld-crews stick their necks out?"

choices.label: "Clan to clan, Forgemaster—Ironkin don't let Syndicate bailiffs starve an honest dock."
choices.hint: Ironkin Dwarf solidarity — guaranteed Ironkin backing for Siltport

onSuccess.resultText: Durn slams a fist against his chestplate and laughs. "Blood and rivets! Tell Renn the Slag Foundry's weld-crews stand behind Siltport."

choices.label: "Old Iron Bramwell sent me. Remember the Tariff Wars? Siltport is holding that line."
choices.hint: Presence check (DC 6, +3 if Bramwell Trust 2+)

onSuccess.resultText: Durn's brow lifts at Bramwell's name. "If Old Iron says you're solid, that's good enough for me. We'll send a dozen weld-hands to Siltport."

onFailure.resultText: Durn shakes his head. "Bramwell's a good man, but words don't pay fuel bills. I'll sell you scrap, not a militia."

choices.label: "I'm not asking for a militia, Durn—just fair salvage rates and open berth."

onSuccess.resultText: Durn nods approvingly. "Plain talk. My berth's open whenever you've got slag to haul."

foundry_aftermath_ally.title: Ironkin Backing
paragraphs: Durn stamps an Ironkin guild-token into your palm and signals a loader crane to drop a fresh pallet of refined plates into {{ship}}'s hold. "When Vane-Kael brings his enforcers to Siltport, flash that token. They'll think twice."

choices.label: "Obliged, Forgemaster. See you on the Silt-Line."

onSuccess.resultText: You depart The Slag Foundry with Ironkin solidarity—and a stronger hand for the Tariff Standoff.

foundry_aftermath_neutral.title: Open Berth
paragraphs: Durn claps your shoulder and points toward the dispatch slate. "Check back anytime if you want honest escort or salvage work."

choices.label: "Fair enough. Safe forging, Durn."

onSuccess.resultText: You undock cleanly with a crate of spare foundry scrap.

title: The Blind Eye of Buoy 14
subtitle: Infiltrate Syndicate Buoy 14 to uncover what Vane-Kael is secretly bankrolling with Siltport's tariffs.

start.title: The Customs Spire
paragraphs: Syndicate Buoy 14 rises out of the asteroid shadow like an iron needle—all slate-gray armor, rotating dish-arrays, and green customs beacons. Every tariff ledger in the Inner Drift routes through its encrypted partition.
"Two sentry turrets on the collar, {{firstName}}," SABLE-7 warns. "And the duty bailiff is running active transponder sweeps. How are we getting into that audit core?"

choices.label: Warning: Your hull still carries a Syndicate transponder tag! Spoof the sentry lock first
choices.hint: Sensors Lv.2 or Guile check (DC 7) to scrub the alert before docking

onSuccess.resultText: You feed a phantom cargo transponder into the buoy's receiver, blinding the sentry lock cleanly.

onFailure.resultText: A sentry turret clips your port flank as you dive under its arc into the blind-spot collar!

choices.label: Coast into the spire's radar shadow and prep your breach

onSuccess.resultText: You cut main thrusters and drift silently beneath the lower dish-array.

buoy_approach.title: Into the Partition
paragraphs: Mag-clamps locked, the buoy's external data-port and customs airlock sit twenty meters apart along the hull spine. Choose your entry.

choices.label: Siphon the audit partition silently with Void Cryptography or Resonant Bypass Rig
choices.hint: Guile check (DC 6, +3 Void Cryptography, +4 Resonant Bypass Rig)

onSuccess.resultText: You splice straight into the encrypted relay without tripping a single customs alarm.

onFailure.resultText: A counter-intrusion spike fries your splice-cable and trips the spire's klaxon!

choices.label: Hail the duty bailiff using Syndicate protocol or sharp Presence
choices.hint: Presence check (DC 7, +3 if Syndicate Defector)

onSuccess.resultText: You rattle off an urgent tariff-reconciliation code; the half-asleep bailiff unlocks the ledger mirror for you.

onFailure.resultText: The bailiff spots the mismatch on his slate and hits the lockdown siren!

choices.label: Blow the airlock hatch and storm the relay room by force
choices.hint: Grit check (DC 7, +3 Plasma Marksmanship / Phase Carbine)

onSuccess.resultText: Stun-smoke and plasma fire clear the relay room in thirty seconds flat. You yank the audit drive straight out of the rack.

onFailure.resultText: Automated bulkhead shutters slam down on your arm and scorch your hull as you fight to the rack!

buoy_alarm_scramble.title: Hot Extraction
paragraphs: Red strobes flood the buoy's hull. You rip the physical audit drive free while grazing turret fire rakes {{ship}}'s stern.

choices.label: Punch the throttle and decrypt the drive in open vacuum

onSuccess.resultText: You clear the buoy's firing arc with scorched plating—but the drive is yours.

buoy_audit_reveal.title: The Anchor-9 Ledger
paragraphs: Back in safe space, SABLE-7 unpacks the encrypted Buoy 14 partition across your canopy. It isn't corporate greed—not simply. Every credit Vane-Kael squeezed out of Siltport's vaporator debt was wired straight to an unlisted Deep Frontier station: **Anchor-9**.

"Containment spikes, void-anchors, and orbital scuttling charges," SABLE-7 reads aloud. "Vane-Kael isn't just taxing the rim, {{firstName}}. He's building a cage around the Singing Monolith—and he's heading to Siltport now to lock the port down for good."

choices.label: "Then let's get back to Cantina Row and meet him head-on."

onSuccess.resultText: You archive Vane-Kael's Private Audit—more than enough leverage for the standoff ahead.

title: The Tariff Standoff
subtitle: Act II Climax — Collector Vane-Kael arrives at Cantina Row to impound Siltport's gantry.

start.title: The Ledger's Shadow
paragraphs: Four armored Syndicate enforcers form a half-circle in the dust of Rust & Cantina Row. Collector Vane-Kael stands at their center, slate-gray wool coat immaculate despite the red wind, his silver stylus hovering over an impoundment writ.

Dockmaster Renn stands by the gantry switch with a heavy iron spanner; behind the tin shutters, half of Siltport watches in tense silence. "Forty days in arrears," Vane-Kael announces crisply. "Settle the balance, or step aside while we lock the cranes."

choices.label: "You're not collecting port debt, Vane-Kael. You're bankrolling Anchor-9 out of Siltport's hides."
choices.hint: Use Vane-Kael's Private Audit from Buoy 14 to expose him

onSuccess.resultText: A sharp murmur ripples under the tin awnings as you project the Buoy 14 audit across the alley wall. Vane-Kael's silver stylus stops moving.

choices.label: Step between Vane-Kael and Renn: "Let's talk terms, Collector."

onSuccess.resultText: Vane-Kael eyes you up and down, tapping his stylus. "Ah, Captain {{lastName}}. The pilot poking around the Kestrel. Let's see how you play your hand."

vanekael_anchor9_debate.title: The Containment Mandate
paragraphs: Vane-Kael doesn't flinch—instead, his voice drops low enough that only you and Renn can hear. "You think I enjoy squeezing rust-towns, Captain {{lastName}}? Look at what happened to the *Kestrel* when her experimental relay-key sang."

"Three hundred years ago, the Pre-Collapse Lattice tore half the sector's stars apart. Anchor-9 is the only thing keeping the Deep Frontier quiet. If Siltport goes lawless, smugglers and Choir zealots will wake the Monolith—and burn us all."

choices.label: "Fear doesn't give you the right to starve this town, Vane-Kael."

onSuccess.resultText: Vane-Kael inclines his head a millimeter. "Then show me what you're offering instead."

standoff_climax.title: Siltport's Future
paragraphs: Enforcers rest their palms on stun-carbines. Renn tightens his grip on the gantry switch. "Choose carefully, Captain {{lastName}}," Vane-Kael purrs. "Back a stubborn dust-town, or make an arrangement that actually keeps the dark at bay."

choices.label: Rally Siltport, Ironkin, and the crowd to expel the Syndicate and declare a Free Charter
choices.hint: Presence check (DC 8) — boosted by Cantina, Renn/Bramwell Trust, and Buoy 14 Audit

onSuccess.resultText: Cheers erupt as dockhands, salvagers, and Ironkin weld-crews close ranks behind you. Outnumbered and exposed, Vane-Kael holsters his stylus and retreats to his shuttle. Siltport raises its own free-port seal.

onFailure.resultText: Vane-Kael's enforcers fire warning stun-bolts into the tin awnings, driving the crowd back half a pace—the standoff teeters on a knife's edge!

choices.label: "Keep your customs banners up, Vane-Kael—but Siltport's inner ring is untaxed, and I keep Anchor-9's ledger."
choices.hint: Requires Audit Intel, Guile 3+, or Cutthroat/Ghost — carve out a shadow-broker deal

onSuccess.resultText: Vane-Kael smiles thinly and signs the quiet exemption. The Syndicate keeps face, Siltport keeps breathing, and your hull carries an untouchable shadow-pass.

choices.label: Back Vane-Kael's containment mandate under Syndicate oversight and take a contractor's cut
choices.hint: Pragmatic Syndicate pact — heavy credits & salvage, costs Renn's trust

onSuccess.resultText: Vane-Kael stamps the ledger with a crisp nod. Customs banners rise over Cantina Row—orderly, taxed, and lucrative for captains who back Syndicate order.

standoff_crackdown.title: Line in the Red Dust
paragraphs: Stun-smoke drifts across the alley. Renn plants his boots beside the gantry switch, bleeding from a grazed cheek. "Your call, {{firstName}}—we hold the cranes and take the bruising, or we cut a backroom truce right now."

choices.label: Hold the line and eat the enforcers' fire until Vane-Kael backs down (-18 Hull, -30 Cr)

onSuccess.resultText: You take a stun-baton across the ribs and drag the gantry lock shut yourself. Bruised and short on coin, Siltport still stands free.

choices.label: Pivot to a quiet backroom truce to stop the bloodshed

onSuccess.resultText: You signal Renn to lower the spanner and sign a compromise exemption with Vane-Kael—no one is happy, but nobody bleeds.

act2_milestone.title: Act II Milestone · Beyond the Outer Buoys
paragraphs: "Siltport's charter is settled, {{firstName}}," SABLE-7 reports as the dust clears over the pad. "Vane-Kael's Deep Frontier black-site—Anchor-9—is now on our star-chart, and the Singing Monolith is waiting beyond the Glass Shoals."
"Before we upgrade for the Deep Frontier, which of your core capabilities grew sharpest through the Mid-Drift?"

choices.label: Grit — enduring vitrified wrecks and Syndicate fire (+1 Grit)

onSuccess.resultText: You've proven you won't fold when the hull groans.

choices.label: Guile — cracking Buoy 14 and outmaneuvering bailiffs (+1 Guile)

onSuccess.resultText: Every blind spot on the rim feels sharper now.

choices.label: Tech — jury-rigging fused relays and foundry hardware (+1 Tech)

onSuccess.resultText: Dead circuits yield faster to your touch.

choices.label: Presence — holding crowds and staring down Vane-Kael (+1 Presence)

onSuccess.resultText: Your name carries real weight across the Silt-Line now.

choices.label: Lore — piecing together the Collapse, Choir, and Anchor-9 (+1 Lore)

onSuccess.resultText: The deeper pattern of the sector is finally coming into focus.

choices.label: Resonance — steadying singing cores without breaking (+1 Resonance)

onSuccess.resultText: The Choir's frequency no longer rattles your bones—it answers them.

title: After the Shear
subtitle: Sit with Vexra Korr on Siltport's pad after resolving the Kestrel's missing prow.

start.title: Evening on the Pad
paragraphs: The evening wind cools Siltport's ferro-concrete slabs. Vexra sits on the edge of the gantry ramp with her copper gauntlet resting beside her, watching the amber arc-lamps flicker on across the yard.

choices.label: "Taren's asleep in the bunkhouse, Vexra. How are you holding up?"

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra lets out a long, shaky laugh and leans back on her palms.

choices.label: Sit beside her in silence for a minute before speaking.

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra stares at the red dust between her boots, her jaw tight.

vexra2_saved_beat.title: Debt Paid in Full
paragraphs: "I keep waiting to wake up back in that ward-bubble," Vexra admits, her voice softer than usual. "You didn't just pull me out of the Drift, {{firstName}}—you gave me my brother back. Whatever waits out past the Glass Shoals, I'm riding with you to the end."

choices.label: Take her hand: "We're in this together, Vexra—not just as crew."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra laces her fingers through yours, soot and all, and rests her head briefly against your shoulder.

choices.label: "Glad to have you at my back, sparks. Always."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra grins—bright and unburdened for the first time since you met her.

vexra2_lost_beat.title: Cold Iron
paragraphs: "I built that relay-key," Vexra says flatly. "And I couldn't save him. Don't tell me it wasn't my fault, {{firstName}}—just promise me we don't let whatever's out in the Deep Frontier do that to anyone else."

choices.label: "We'll finish what the Kestrel started. I swear it."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra nods once, wiping her eyes with the back of a grease-stained sleeve.

vexra2_mentorship.title: Masterwork Calibration
paragraphs: "Before we push past the Glass Shoals," Vexra says, picking up her calipers, "let's sharpen your edge. Want advanced sigil-wiring or deep harmonic shielding?"

choices.label: Drill advanced sigil-wiring and overload shunts (+1 Tech)

onSuccess.resultText: Your precision with live ley-conduits jumps a full tier under Vexra's eye.

choices.label: Practice harmonic shielding against Choir surges (+1 Resonance)

onSuccess.resultText: You learn to ground singing static through your fingertips without flinching.

title: Tessa's Last Vector
subtitle: SABLE-7 unlocks Captain Tessa's final flight log from the Glass Shoals.

start.title: Unlocked Partition
paragraphs: The cockpit lights dim to amber. SABLE-7 projects a cracked star-chart of the Glass Shoals above the stick—and opens an encrypted audio partition she has kept sealed since you woke in cryo.
"You trusted me with the *Kestrel* telemetry, {{firstName}}," SABLE-7 says quietly. "It's only fair you hear Captain Tessa's last transmission before she vanished."

choices.label: "Play the log, SABLE."

onSuccess.resultText: Static hisses through the cockpit speakers, followed by a woman's calm, tired voice.

tessa_recording.title: Glass Shoals
paragraphs: "...The shoals aren't empty, SABLE. The Choir Abbey is still lit out here—and the Monolith isn't a weapon. It's a lock. If anyone finds the Lark, tell them not to let the Syndicate shatter the key..."

The recording clicks dead. "She ejected my core pod before her final burn so I'd survive," SABLE-7 murmurs. "I used to think I was just her backup drive. Now I wonder if I'm the part of her that still wants to see how this ends."

choices.label: "You're your own person, SABLE. And we're going to finish her run together."
