onSuccess.resultText: SABLE-7's cyan projector brightens warmly. "Copy that, {{firstName}}. Preparing deep-frontier navigation drills."

sable2_mentorship.title: Deep-Reef Navigation
paragraphs: "Pick your focus for the night shift," SABLE-7 offers.

choices.label: Decode Tessa's Glass Shoals archive notes (+1 Lore)

onSuccess.resultText: Tessa's margin annotations illuminate half the Deep Frontier's forgotten beacons.

choices.label: Calibrate the nav-core harmonic filter by ear (+1 Resonance)

onSuccess.resultText: You and SABLE-7 tune the copper conduits until the three-note pulse rings crystal clear.

title: The Choir's Price
subtitle: Sister Mirek examines the Anchor-9 audit and reveals where the Void Choir still survives.

start.title: Blue Lamplight
paragraphs: Behind the tin shutter, Mirek turns your Anchor-9 telemetry over in her pale, gaunt hands. "So Vane-Kael really built a cage around the Monolith," she whispers, a bitter smile touching her lips.
"If he trips those scuttling charges at Anchor-9, he won't just silence the Lattice—he'll shatter the Listening Abbey out past the Glass Shoals. My old sisters and brothers are still out there."

choices.label: "You still care about the Choir, even after burning out your sight?"

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek lowers her hood, her scarred eyes catching the blue alcohol flame.

mirek2_truth.title: Unbroken Ties
paragraphs: "I left their vows, {{firstName}}, not their lives," Mirek says quietly. "When you jump to the Deep Frontier, seek out the Listening Abbey before Anchor-9 fires. Tell Cantrix Vey that 'Ash-Glass' sent you."

choices.label: "I'll carry your word to the Abbey, Mirek. Stay safe till I'm back."

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek catches your wrist for a brief, warm second before stepping back into shadow.

mirek2_mentorship.title: Deep-Reef Ciphers
paragraphs: "Take one more lesson before the deep reef," Mirek murmurs.

choices.label: Master black-site counter-surveillance (+1 Guile)

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek drills you on slipping Syndicate black-site patrols and dead-band comms.

choices.label: Study the Listening Abbey's elder liturgy (+1 Lore)

onSuccess.resultText: You memorize the elder Choir pass-phrases and harmonic keys.

title: Old Guard at the Kettle
subtitle: Share a late-night bottle with Dockmaster Renn and Old Iron Bramwell.

start.title: Three Tin Mugs
paragraphs: For once, nobody is arguing over scrap prices in Cantina Row. Renn and Bramwell have claimed the corner table with a dusty bottle of pre-war rust-gin and three battered tin mugs.

"Sit down, {{firstName}}," Renn grunts, sliding a mug across the scarred wood. "Two old men arguing about the Tariff Wars isn't half as entertaining without a captain who actually flies past the buoys."

choices.label: Clink mugs with both of them: "To Siltport—still standing."

onSuccess.resultText: For an hour, there are no bailiffs, no ledgers, and no broken ships—just dry jokes, old scars, and the quiet comfort of people who have your back.

old_guard_mentorship.title: Hard-Won Wisdom
paragraphs: "Before we call it a night, cap," Bramwell grins, "pick what you want drilled into your bones."

choices.label: Bramwell's zero-g endurance & heavy-hull conditioning (+1 Grit)

onSuccess.resultText: You leave the table feeling iron-ribbed and steady.

choices.label: Renn's rim-politics & command instincts (+1 Presence)

onSuccess.resultText: You leave the table knowing exactly how to hold a room—or a whole port.

title: Foundry Escort & Salvage Sweep
subtitle: Clear slag-mines or haul induction coils for Forgemaster Durn in the Mid-Drift.

start.title: Foundry Dispatch
paragraphs: Durn's crane-master flags your ship as you clear the berth. "Got two hot jobs in the Mid-Drift—floating Tariff War mines fouling our slag-lanes, or a rush coil-delivery past Syndicate patrol buoys. Both pay honest weight."

choices.label: Defuse drifting Tariff War mines along the barge lane
choices.hint: Tech check (DC 6, +2 Sensors Lv.2) — 50 Cr & 2 Salvage on success

onSuccess.resultText: You disarm three magnetic mines cleanly and tow their copper casings straight back to Durn's cranes.

onFailure.resultText: One mine clips your bow shield as it detonates—yet Durn still pays hazard rate for clearing the lane.

choices.label: Run heavy induction coils past Mid-Drift patrol buoys
choices.hint: Guile check (DC 6, +2 Cargo or Drive Lv.2) — 55 Cr & 1 Salvage on success

onSuccess.resultText: You slip cleanly through the buoy shadow and collect full foundry hazard pay.

onFailure.resultText: A patrol flare forces a long detour through the slag belt, trimming your bonus—still a solid haul.

title: Ships of Singing Glass
subtitle: Thread The Cinder Lark through a graveyard of vitrified hulls to find Captain Tessa's Starling.

start.title: The Prism Reef
paragraphs: Starlight splinters into violet and cyan needles as {{ship}} drops out of ley-burn. Ahead stretches The Glass Shoals—dozens of freighters, courier brigs, and Pre-Collapse skiffs frozen in mid-drift, their steel hulls vitrified into ringing crystal.

"There," SABLE-7 whispers, highlighting a slender courier hull wedged between two shattered ore-barges. "The *Starling*. Captain Tessa's ship. Her emergency beacon is dead, yet the harmonic echo is coming straight from her flight deck."

choices.label: Thread the glass needles using Aether-Spectrum Sensors or Guile
choices.hint: Guile check (DC 7, +3 Sensors Lv.2, +2 SABLE-7 Trust 2+)

onSuccess.resultText: You slip {{ship}} between razor-edged crystal spars without a single scrape, kissing the Starling's intact aft airlock.

onFailure.resultText: A spinning shard of vitrified plating rakes {{ship}}'s starboard flank, screaming across the hull before you lock clamps.

choices.label: Ride the harmonic drift with Resonance or Taren's Brass Ley-Compass
choices.hint: Resonance check (DC 7, +2 Taren's Compass, +2 Phase-Weaving)

onSuccess.resultText: You match the reef's three-note cadence on the thrusters; the crystal spars seem to part cleanly around your wake.

onFailure.resultText: A sudden discordant gust slams {{ship}} into a frozen freighter fin, rattling every bulkhead as you dock.

starling_deck.title: Aboard the Starling
paragraphs: The *Starling*'s cockpit is a still museum of frost and brass. Captain Tessa isn't at the helm—only an empty flight suit slumped cleanly beside a frost-rimed echo-core strapped to the nav-console.

"She stayed behind to record the Monolith's true telemetry," SABLE-7 says softly as you unclip the core. Across your visor, Tessa's final survey unfolds: the Pre-Collapse Lattice didn't break the stars. **The Singing Monolith is a stabilizing keystone holding back a deep-void shear.** If Anchor-9 shatters it with cold iron, the shockwave will vitrify half the sector.

choices.label: "Archive Tessa's Echo-Core, SABLE. Vane-Kael needs to see this before Anchor-9 fires."

onSuccess.resultText: You seal the frost-rimed core inside your pack—proof that the Monolith is a lock, not a weapon.

shoals_exit.title: Out of the Reef
paragraphs: As {{ship}} backs clear of the *Starling*, SABLE-7 marks two clean coordinates on your Deep Frontier chart: *The Listening Abbey* and *Black-Site Anchor-9*.

choices.label: "Clear the reef and set course."

onSuccess.resultText: You glide back into open starlight with Tessa's Echo-Core humming quietly in your hold.

title: Hymn of the Hollow Comet
subtitle: Parley with Cantrix Vey inside The Listening Abbey before Anchor-9 opens fire.

start.title: The Comet Nave
paragraphs: The hollowed iron comet opens into a vast, dim cathedral of riveted ribs and tall quartz tuning-spires. Acoustic dishes hum overhead like distant organ pipes. Robed archivists pause in the aisles as Cantrix Vey—tall, silver-haired, wearing a brass resonator collar—steps forward to meet you.

"Another ship from the Silt-Line," Vey says, her voice carrying effortlessly through the vaulted air. "Few captains cross the Glass Shoals unless they're hunting Choir relics—or carrying Syndicate charges."

choices.label: "Sister Mirek—'Ash-Glass'—sent me to warn you about Anchor-9."
choices.hint: Uses Sister Mirek's pass-phrase from Bond Tier 2

onSuccess.resultText: Cantrix Vey's stern expression breaks into quiet astonishment. "Mirek still lives—and still remembers us? Then you stand here as a friend of the Abbey."

choices.label: "I'm the captain who kept Courier Lyra's Choir urn out of Syndicate hands."

onSuccess.resultText: Vey inclines her head deeply. "The runner spoke of you. Our dead's voices are safe because of your nerve."

choices.label: Meet Vey's gaze evenly: "We have an urgent problem in common, Cantrix."

onSuccess.resultText: Two Abbey wardens step closer, their brass tuning staves humming softly.

abbey_test.title: Measured Harmonies
paragraphs: "Words are light in vacuum, captain," Vey says coolly. "Convince me you came to preserve the sector, not strip the Monolith bare."

choices.label: Make your case with Presence or Lore
choices.hint: Presence check (DC 7, +2 Tessa's Echo-Core, +2 Oathkeeper)

onSuccess.resultText: Vey listens carefully, then lowers her staff. "Very well. You speak like someone who has seen the reef's weight."

onFailure.resultText: Vey shakes her head. "We will not hand our sacred key to an unproven drifter. Survive Anchor-9 first, and we may speak again."

abbey_council.title: The Harmonic Key
paragraphs: Cantrix Vey lifts a delicate silver-and-quartz resonator from the altar—**Cantrix Vey's Harmonic Key**. "The Singing Monolith has been drifting out of tune for centuries," she explains. "If you carry this key into its echo chamber, you can harmonize the keystone cleanly—or, if you choose to silence it, do so without triggering a shear."

choices.label: "I'll carry the Key to the Monolith, Cantrix. Thank you."

onSuccess.resultText: The silver resonator chimes once against your palm, warming to your pulse.

abbey_strained_exit.title: Closed Lancets
paragraphs: The Abbey's outer shutters begin to roll shut, though Vey tosses a single raw Aether Shard toward your airlock as a parting gesture of bare courtesy.

choices.label: "Have it your way, Cantrix. We'll handle Anchor-9 ourselves."

onSuccess.resultText: You undock from the silent comet, carrying only what you brought.

title: Iron Over the Abyss
subtitle: Confront Collector Vane-Kael at Black-Site Anchor-9 before its grounding lances shatter the Monolith.

start.title: The Dread-Ring
paragraphs: Black-Site Anchor-9 hangs like an iron crown above the Deep Frontier—six massive cold-iron lance pylons rotating around a central command spire. Pale blue arcs crawl up the barrels as the ring charges toward the Singing Monolith's coordinates.
"Twelve minutes to full lance discharge, {{firstName}}," SABLE-7 reports. "Collector Vane-Kael's flagship is docked at the central hub."

choices.label: Transmit your Syndicate clearance / Shadow-Pass to dock directly at the command hub

onSuccess.resultText: Anchor-9's traffic controller clears your approach without a shot fired, locking your ship onto the command collar.

choices.label: Slip through the sentry blind-spot or punch straight into the hub collar
choices.hint: Guile check (DC 7, +3 Sensors Lv.2) — clean dock, or eat grazing sentry fire

onSuccess.resultText: You hug the shadow of a rotating lance pylon and clamp onto the hub airlock unnoticed.

onFailure.resultText: Point-defense cannons rake {{ship}}'s bow plating before you slam through the inner collar!

anchor9_confrontation.title: The Bailiff's Gamble
paragraphs: Inside Anchor-9's glass-walled command deck, Collector Vane-Kael stands alone before the firing console, watching the Monolith shimmer on a wide holo-sphere. He doesn't draw a weapon as you step through the hatch—only rests one gloved hand above the launch key.

"You came all this way, Captain {{lastName}}," Vane-Kael says quietly, exhaustion finally showing beneath his immaculate collar. "Every tariff, every sleepless night, every town that hated my name—all of it bought this ring. One strike, and the Monolith can never wake a second Collapse. Tell me why I shouldn't press this key."

choices.label: Project Captain Tessa's Echo-Core: "Because the Monolith is a lock, Vane-Kael—shatter it and you vitrify the whole sector!"
choices.hint: Requires Tessa's Echo-Core — Presence check (DC 7, +3 Echo-Core, +2 Vane-Kael Trust 1+)

onSuccess.resultText: Vane-Kael stares at Tessa's telemetry for five agonizing seconds—and slowly pulls his hand back from the key. "Stars forgive me," he whispers, handing you the Anchor-9 Scuttling Override. "Go fix what I nearly broke."

onFailure.resultText: Vane-Kael's jaw locks in terror. "No—it's a Choir trick!" He reaches for the launch key—you have seconds to stop him!

choices.label: Slip a bypass spike into the command console to lock the lances cold
choices.hint: Tech check (DC 7, +3 Void Cryptography, +4 Resonant Bypass Rig)

onSuccess.resultText: The firing relays snap dead in a cascade of amber breakers. Vane-Kael watches helplessly as you pocket the Scuttling Override.

onFailure.resultText: A security arc blows your spike clear across the deck as Vane-Kael hits the countdown!

choices.label: Open fire on the command relays and shatter Anchor-9's lance ring
choices.hint: Grit check (DC 7, +3 Plasma Marksmanship, +4 Phase Carbine)

onSuccess.resultText: Plasma bolts rip through the lance-capacitor busbars. Vane-Kael dives for an escape pod as the firing ring breaks apart in silent fire.

onFailure.resultText: Ricocheting bolts and emergency bulkheads pin you down while the lance ring hits 90% charge!

anchor9_forced_hand.title: Emergency Scuttle
paragraphs: "Lances at ninety-five percent!" SABLE-7 warns. "Ramming the ring's central coolant pylon with {{ship}} will break the firing arc—now!"

choices.label: Sprint back to the airlock and ram the coolant pylon (-18 Hull)

onSuccess.resultText: You slam {{ship}} through the pylon's latticework, shearing the ring dead in a shower of frozen coolant while Vane-Kael's shuttle flees into the dark.

act3_milestone.title: Act III Milestone · Before the Keystone
paragraphs: "Anchor-9 is neutralized, {{firstName}}," SABLE-7 breathes. "The Singing Monolith lies straight ahead—unguarded, humming at full pitch. Everything we've built across the Drift comes down to what we do there."
"Before we make the final burn, which of your instincts is sharpest?"

choices.label: Grit — unbreakable under deep-rim fire (+1 Grit)

onSuccess.resultText: You're ready for whatever the void throws back.

choices.label: Guile — slipping reefs and black-sites unseen (+1 Guile)

onSuccess.resultText: Nothing in the deep dark catches you flat-footed.

choices.label: Tech — mastering Syndicate and Pre-Collapse hardware (+1 Tech)

onSuccess.resultText: Every relay in the sector answers your wrench.

choices.label: Presence — changing minds even at the edge of the abyss (+1 Presence)

onSuccess.resultText: Your voice carries across fleets and cathedrals alike.

choices.label: Lore — unlocking the true history of the Collapse (+1 Lore)

onSuccess.resultText: The Architects' design is clear in your mind.

choices.label: Resonance — standing eye-to-eye with the Choir's song (+1 Resonance)

onSuccess.resultText: You can hear every harmonic thread in the Deep Frontier.

title: Echo-Drift Survey
subtitle: Salvage high-grade shards and relics from the outer Glass Shoals.

start.title: Crystal Wrecks
paragraphs: Two vitrified courier hulls drift slowly along the shoals' outer rim, their shard-collectors still glowing faintly in the starlight.

choices.label: Extract intact aether-coils with precision Sensors & Tech
choices.hint: Tech check (DC 7, +2 Sensors Lv.2, +2 Cargo Lv.2) — 75 Cr, 2 Shards, 2 Salvage

onSuccess.resultText: You lift two pristine coils and a pair of Aether Shards clean out of the crystal hull.

onFailure.resultText: A brittle spar snaps against your scoop, denting plating—still a profitable haul.

choices.label: Skim loose shards from the outer drift without waking the shear
choices.hint: Guile check (DC 6, +2 Drive Lv.2) — 65 Cr, 1 Shard, 1 Salvage

onSuccess.resultText: Clean, silent, and fast—your hold fills without a single harmonic spike.

onFailure.resultText: You burn extra thrusters dodging a tumbling shard-cluster, trimming your net profit.

title: Starlight & Solder
subtitle: Before the final jump, Vexra welds a custom silver brace onto The Cinder Lark.

start.title: The Final Weld
paragraphs: Blue-white arc light dances across the Magi-Tech Bay as Vexra finishes etching a silver harmonic brace directly into {{ship}}'s main bulkhead. She flips up her welding visor and smiles—tired, soot-streaked, and completely at home aboard your ship.

choices.label: Pull her into a quiet embrace beside the warm bench.

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra sets her torch down and leans into you, laughing softly against your collar. "Don't get yourself vitrified out there, {{firstName}}—I just finished tuning this hull."

choices.label: "Looks like she'll hold anything the Deep Frontier throws at us."

onSuccess.resultText: Vexra pats the warm silver brace with pride. "If she cracks, it won't be on my welds."

vexra3_vow.title: Master Artificer's Edge
paragraphs: "One last tune-up before the Monolith," Vexra says. "What do you want calibrated?"

choices.label: Master-grade relay & armor calibration (+1 Tech)

onSuccess.resultText: You and Vexra lock every system aboard The Cinder Lark to peak tolerance.

choices.label: Harmonic resonance bracing for the Monolith (+1 Resonance)

onSuccess.resultText: The silver brace hums in clean sympathy with your own pulse.

title: The Fourth Captain
subtitle: After finding the Starling, SABLE-7 claims her own name beside you at the helm.

start.title: Quiet Canopy
paragraphs: With Tessa's Echo-Core resting on the console, the cockpit feels different—clearer, as if a long-held breath finally left the ship. SABLE-7's holographic amber ring pulses steadily above the throttles.
"I archived Tessa's log in the deep memory," SABLE-7 says gently. "I'm not Orlov, I'm not the courier, and I'm not Tessa. I'm SABLE-7—and {{ship}} is my home as much as yours."

choices.label: "Then let's fly this last run together, partner."

onSuccess.resultText: SABLE-7's projection brightens with a crisp, warm chime. "Locked in, {{firstName}}."

sable3_mentorship.title: Full Sync
paragraphs: "Final nav-sync ready. Pick our last calibration focus."

choices.label: Synthesize Tessa's complete Architects archive (+1 Lore)

onSuccess.resultText: Every piece of the Pre-Collapse puzzle locks cleanly into your HUD.

choices.label: Attune cockpit conduits to your pulse (+1 Resonance)

onSuccess.resultText: You and SABLE-7 breathe in the exact same rhythm as the nav-core.

title: Lanterns on the Rim
subtitle: A quiet eve-of-finale vigil in Cantina Row before you face the Singing Monolith.

start.title: Before the Dark
paragraphs: Lanterns sway gently beneath Cantina Row's tin awnings. Sister Mirek waits beside the brazier with two clay cups of hot spiced sage—and if Courier Lyra is still in your corner, she's perched on the crate beside her, tossing rust-nuts into the coals.
"Everyone on the rim knows you're burning for the Monolith soon," Mirek says softly. "Come sit a minute before you leave the dust behind."

choices.label: "Wait for me to bring the sky back, Mirek."

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek touches your cheek briefly with cool, steady fingers. "I'll keep the lantern lit, {{firstName}}."

choices.label: Catch Lyra's eye: "Save me a seat on the Copper Kettle roof when I'm back."

onSuccess.resultText: Lyra flashes a fierce, warm grin. "First round's on me, cap. Come back whole."

choices.label: Share the cup in quiet solidarity: "Keep Siltport steady while I'm out."

onSuccess.resultText: Mirek inclines her head. "Our eyes and ears are yours, captain."

mirek3_mentorship.title: Parting Edge
paragraphs: "One final edge for the road," Mirek murmurs.

choices.label: Ghost-lane evasion & silent approaches (+1 Guile)

onSuccess.resultText: You leave the brazier moving like a shadow.

choices.label: Unshakeable composure under impossible odds (+1 Presence)

onSuccess.resultText: Nothing in the Deep Frontier will rattle your nerve.

title: The Singing Monolith
subtitle: Act III Climax — Three hundred meters of matte-black basalt hum at the heart of the Deep Frontier.

start.title: The Fluted Threshold
paragraphs: As {{ship}} drops out of ley-burn, the Singing Monolith fills the entire canopy—three hundred meters of matte-black basalt suspended upright in vacuum, ringed by slowly turning halos of ancient brass. A deep, three-note chord vibrates straight through the deck plates into your teeth.
Across the comms, a fractured Pre-Collapse voice—half-static, half-choir—speaks your name: "...{{name}}... Vessel-key detected. The Keystone awaits an answer."

choices.label: Raise Aegis Hull-Weave to buffer the harmonic shockwave
choices.hint: Magi-Tech Synergy — glide inside the brass rings unscathed

onSuccess.resultText: Your hull-weave shimmers violet, drinking the shockwave cleanly. The obelisk's fluted script parts like a curtain.

choices.label: Broadcast Cantrix Vey's Harmonic Key across the outer rings
choices.hint: Uses Cantrix Vey's Harmonic Key — clean passage

onSuccess.resultText: The shattered brass halos chime in answer and align into a calm, luminous corridor.

choices.label: Transmit the Pre-Collapse Lattice greeting from your archives
choices.hint: Lore check (DC 7, +2 Archive Lv.1) — calm the outer rings

onSuccess.resultText: The shattered brass rings align in slow majesty, opening a calm corridor to the obelisk's base.

onFailure.resultText: A harmonic pulse slams {{ship}}'s bow, cracking outer glass—yet the rings still part before you.

echo_chamber.title: The Keystone's Choice
paragraphs: Inside the calm eye of the brass rings, pale cyan glyphs breathe across the basalt face. "{{firstName}}," SABLE-7 whispers, her holographic slate steady in your palm. "This is the keystone holding the Deep Frontier together."
"We can harmonize it to reopen safe star-lanes across the sector, anchor it quietly into dormancy with cold iron, or carve its resonant core dry for ourselves."

choices.label: Harmonize the Keystone and awaken the Deep Frontier star-lanes
choices.hint: Resonance check (DC 8, +2 Phase-Weaving, +2 Choir Key, +2 Echo-Core, +2 SABLE-7 Trust 3+)

onSuccess.resultText: Pale cyan script blazes up the three-hundred-meter face in a breathtaking chord. Across the Deep Frontier, dead beacons flare to life—and a slate-black tuning fork detaches from the plinth into your scoop.

onFailure.resultText: Aether lightning erupts across the canopy as the harmonic feedback threatens to tear the keystone apart!

choices.label: Anchor the Keystone into quiet dormancy with cold iron
choices.hint: Tech check (DC 8, +2 Jury-Rigging, +3 Anchor-9 Override, +2 Vexra Trust 3+)

onSuccess.resultText: The grounding spike locks cleanly into the plinth. The Monolith's dangerous hum drops to a harmless, steady whisper—safe for generations.

onFailure.resultText: The grounding spike jams halfway in a shower of sparks—the keystone's shear wave starts building!

choices.label: Bleed the Keystone's core dry for pure Aether Shards and Syndicate bounty
choices.hint: Cutthroat extraction — maximum shards & credits (+2 Cutthroat)

onSuccess.resultText: You carve five pristine Aether Shards straight out of the basalt plinth, leaving the obelisk scorched, hollow, and trembling.

monolith_crisis_beat.title: Holding the Shear
paragraphs: "Hull stress critical!" SABLE-7 calls out as frost-blue static arcs across your console. "We can dump reactor reserve into the plinth to finish stabilizing it—now!"

choices.label: Channel the surge through your own frame and finish harmonizing the Keystone (-22 Hull)

onSuccess.resultText: White-hot static burns frost-blue scars up your arms, yet the Monolith answers with a clean, resonant chime and yields its tuning fork.

choices.label: Ram the grounding spike home with {{ship}}'s bow thrusters (-22 Hull)

onSuccess.resultText: Plating buckles across your bow as the spike seats home, locking the Monolith dark and silent.

monolith_aftermath.title: Homeward Vector
paragraphs: The Deep Frontier settles around {{ship}}. SABLE-7 plots a clean green burn straight back toward Siltport Outpost. "Everyone back at the pad is waiting to hear how this ended, {{firstName}}."

choices.label: "Set course for Siltport. Let's bring The Cinder Lark home."

onSuccess.resultText: You fire the main drive and turn your prow toward the warm amber lights of the Silt-Line.

title: The Lattice Reckoning
subtitle: Act IV Epilogue — Return to Siltport Outpost to see how your choices reshaped the Drift.

start.title: Touchdown at Siltport
paragraphs: As {{ship}}'s landing struts kiss Siltport's ferro-concrete pad, the red wind feels warmer than the day you limped in on fumes. Dockhands line the perimeter fence, waving amber signal-lamps as your boarding ramp hisses down.

Dockmaster Renn and Old Iron Bramwell wait at the bottom of the ladder—and beside them stand the allies you kept along the way. "Welcome home, {{firstName}}," Renn grins, slapping a hand onto your shoulder. "Whole sector felt that pulse from the Deep Frontier. Tell us what's waiting out past the buoys."

choices.label: Raise a glass to Siltport's Free Charter and share the Deep Frontier news

onSuccess.resultText: A cheer rises across the pad—Siltport flies its own seal, unbowed and debt-free.

choices.label: Toast the Shadow Truce—Siltport breathes free while the Syndicate looks the other way

onSuccess.resultText: Renn and Mirek exchange a knowing nod—the cranes spin, untaxed and quiet.

choices.label: Brief the dock crew on the new balance of power on the Silt-Line

onSuccess.resultText: The gantry crews listen intently as you lay out what comes next for the outpost.

epilogue_monolith_echo.title: Echoes Across the Sector
paragraphs: Above Siltport's gantry, the evening sky holds its breath. Out beyond the Inner Drift, your choice at the Singing Monolith has already begun to ripple across every listening post on the rim.

choices.label: Watch the new cyan star-lanes shimmer across the deep-rim sky

onSuccess.resultText: For the first time in three centuries, safe ley-currents link Siltport to the Listening Abbey and uncharted worlds beyond.

choices.label: Enjoy the rare, unbroken stillness of a silenced Deep Frontier

onSuccess.resultText: No ghost-signals, no vitrifying shears—the Drift belongs purely to iron, copper, and honest pilots again.

choices.label: Check the heavy lockbox of Monolith shards humming in your hold

onSuccess.resultText: You walked away richer than any bailiff on the rim—even if the deep-rim dark feels a little colder tonight.

epilogue_crew.title: The Ones Who Stayed
paragraphs: As the crowd drifts back toward the Copper Kettle's warm lights, the people who walked through fire with you linger beside {{ship}}'s ramp—Vexra wiping solder-flux from her gauntlet, Mirek and Lyra under the awnings, Bramwell and Renn by the gantry, and SABLE-7 glowing softly in the open cockpit.

choices.label: "Siltport is home now. Let's keep building this port into something the Core can't ignore."

onSuccess.resultText: Renn raises his wrench in salute, and your crew laughs as the Copper Kettle's lights spill across the pad. (Campaign Complete — the frontier remains open to explore, upgrade, and fly.)

choices.label: "The sky's wide open, SABLE. Let's top off the cells and see what's past the next horizon."

onSuccess.resultText: SABLE-7 chimes a bright departure chord as your crew climbs aboard. (Campaign Complete — the frontier remains open to explore, upgrade, and fly.)
